question.en:
The calorific value of liquefied petroleum gas is as high as 4.6×10^7 J/kg. Some unscrupulous sellers mix liquefied petroleum gas with dimethyl ether, which is cheap and has a calorific value of only 2.9×10^7 J/kg, and sell it to customers in cylinders. Therefore, the quality monitoring department tested the bottled gas sold by a liquefied petroleum gas station: 100 kg of water at an initial temperature of 25°C was placed in a container and heated using a high-efficiency stove until [X], at which point the water just started boiling. 1.2 kg of gas in the cylinder was consumed. Through the high-efficiency stove, water can absorb 70% of the heat released by the complete combustion of the gas. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), ask:  
What is the calorific value of the gas in the cylinder? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  time is 60 s。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an open square, the city government plans to lay a layer of solar panels with uniform thickness to meet the city's energy needs. The power generation efficiency of the solar panels per unit area is 200W/m², with an average daily sunlight time of 5 hours. The solar panels covering the entire square need to generate a total of 62,500,000,000 watt-hours of electricity per day. Please calculate the total area of the square in square meters.
question.zh:
液化石油气的热值高达4.6×10^7J/kg，一些不法商贩为谋取暴利，常将液化石油气与价格低廉、热值仅为2.9×10^7J/kg的二甲醚混合装入钢瓶内销售给客户。为此质量监测部门对某液化石油气站销售的瓶装燃气进行检测：将质量为100kg、初始温度为25℃的水装入容器内，用高效炉灶燃烧瓶内燃气加热容器中的水直至[X]恰好沸腾，瓶内燃气消耗了1.2kg。通过高效炉灶，水能吸收燃气完全燃烧释放热量的70%。已知水的比热容为c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），问：
瓶内燃气的热值是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为60 s。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个开放广场上，市政府计划铺设一层厚度均匀的太阳能板，以满足城市的能源需求。太阳能板的单位面积发电效率为200W/m²，每天平均日照时间为5小时，整个广场的太阳能板需要每天总共产生62500000000.0瓦时的电能。请计算广场的总面积是多少平方米。

zh: [燃气完全燃烧释放出的热量] = [燃气的热值]*[燃气质量]
[水吸收的热量] = [热效率]*[燃气完全燃烧释放出的热量]
[温度变化] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [温度变化]
en: [ heat released from complete combustion of gas] = [ calorific value of gas]*[ mass of gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ thermal efficiency]*[ heat released from complete combustion of gas]
[Temperature change] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [Temperature change]

arguments.zh_name: 燃气完全燃烧释放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gas

question.en:
There is a hand-held rotary brush snow sweeper that can flexibly and nimbly clear snow on the road. The table on the right shows some of its technical parameters. (Take g as 10 N/kg)
Mass150 kg
Driving power when not sweeping snow[X]
Total power when sweeping snow3 kW
Maximum speed1 m/s
The snow sweeper moves at a constant linear speed on the road at maximum speed when not sweeping snow. Find the resistance it experiences; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter Initial temperature is 20 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 10 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an electrical experiment, a student needs to measure the resistance value of an unknown resistor. The experimental setup includes an ideal battery and an ideal ammeter, with the battery's electromotive force being 9 volts. The student connects the unknown resistor to the battery and records the current flowing through the resistor as 0.005 amperes using the ammeter. Based on the experimental data, calculate the resistance value of the unknown resistor.
question.zh: 有一种手扶式滚刷扫雪机，它能轻巧灵活地清打道路上的积雪，右表为其部分技术参数。（g取10N/kg）自身质量150kg不扫雪时行驶功率[X]扫雪时总功率3kW最大行驶速度1m/s扫雪机不扫雪时，在道路上以最大速度匀速直线行驶，求其所受阻力；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数初温的值为20 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 10 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 某电学实验中，学生需要测量一个未知电阻的阻值。实验装置包括一个理想电池和一个理想电流表，并且电池的电动势为9伏特。学生将未知电阻连接到电池上，并通过电流表记录下流过电阻的电流为0.005安培。根据实验数据，计算该未知电阻的阻值。

zh: [功率(不扫雪时行驶)] = [牵引力]*[速度(最大行驶速度)]
en: [Power (non-snow-clearing operation)] = [ Traction force]*[ Speed (maximum operating speed)]

question.en:
The figure shows a solar water heater, into which [X] liters of water is injected. After being exposed to sunlight for a period of time, the water temperature rises from 10 degrees to [X] °C. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C). Please calculate: 

How much heat is absorbed by the water during this time? If during this period the solar water heater receives a total solar radiation heat of 2.8×10^7 J, what is the efficiency of the water heater during this period? The density of water is 1000 kg/m³. The answer to the above questions is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 70 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An object travels with a constant speed, covering a distance of 16 meters on a straight track. It is known that the object maintains a constant speed throughout its travel, and the speed of the object is 5 meters per second. Calculate the time required for the object to cover this distance.
question.zh:
图中是某太阳能热水器，向其中注入[X]L的水，阳光照射﹣段时间后，水温从10升高到[X]℃．水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）。试求：

这段时间水吸收了多少热量？如果这段时间该太阳能热水器接收到太阳辐射的热量是2.8×10^7J，则这段时间该热水器的效率是多少？水的密度为1000kg/m³上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数汽油的热值的值为4.6×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 70 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一个物体以恒定速度行驶，在某条直线轨道上通过了16米的距离。已知该物体在整个行驶过程中保持速度恒定，并且物体的速度为5米/秒。求物体通过这段距离所需的时间。

zh: [水温升高的量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水吸收的热量] = [接收到的太阳辐射热量]*[热水器的效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的量]*[水的比热容])
[水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [ water temperature rise]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ received solar radiant energy]*[efficiency of the heater]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ water temperature rise]*[ specific heat capacity of water])
[ volume of water] = [ mass of water]/[ density of water]

arguments.zh_name: 接收到的太阳辐射热量

question.en:
The engine of an aircraft is a type of heat engine that obtains forward thrust by burning aviation kerosene in the combustion chamber and expelling gas at high speed through the nozzle, as shown in the figure. At high altitude, a certain aircraft obtains a horizontal thrust of 1.6×10^5 N and flies at a constant speed of [X] km/h in the horizontal direction for 1 hour. (The calorific value of aviation kerosene is 4×10^7 J/kg.) Calculate:

The aircraft's range; The answer to the above problem is [Y] The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 6000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A spaceship is traveling away from Earth at a constant speed of 25,000 meters per second. Suppose the spaceship is departing from Earth with the goal of reaching a distant planet located 10,000,050,000 meters away from Earth. Please calculate the time required for the spaceship to reach this planet.
question.zh:
飞机的发动机是一种热机，通过航空煤油在气室中燃烧，从喷口向后高速喷出气体，使发动机获得向前的推力，如图所示，高空中某飞机获得1.6×10^5N的水平推力，以[X]km／h的速度沿水平方向匀速飞行1h。(航空煤油的热值为4×10^7J／kg)求：

飞机的航程；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 6000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一艘太空飞船正以恒定速度飞离地球，速度为25,000米每秒。假设飞船从地球出发，目标是到达一颗遥远的行星，距离地球10,000,050,000米。请计算飞船到达这颗行星所需的时间。

zh: [速度] = [飞机的航程]/[时间]
en: [ speed] = [Range of the aircraft]/[ time]

question.en:
To improve urban air quality, many cities use mist cannon vehicles to spray water and reduce dust. In the figure, a mist cannon vehicle is spraying water on a horizontal road. The area of the outlet at the bottom of the water tank in the vehicle is 50 cm². (Take g as 10 N/kg, \rho_water = 1.0 × 10^3 kg/m^3, and the calorific value of diesel as 4.0 × 10^7 J/kg). Find:

Before spraying water, the mist cannon vehicle is moving in uniform linear motion at a speed of 10 m/s on a horizontal road, with the engine's power being 80 kW. Determine the resistance experienced by the mist cannon vehicle; engine power = [X] W The answer to the above problem is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Time is 1 h。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 30 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A large transmission line uses specially designed superconducting materials to transmit current. Assume the total length of this transmission line is 200 kilometers and it has such a low resistance that the resistance can be neglected. To meet the power demand of the city, this line needs to transmit a total power of 32 megawatts. When the voltage of the transmission line is maintained at 200 volts, calculate the current passing through this transmission line.
question.zh:
为改善城市空气质量，很多城市用雾炮车洒水除尘。如图为一台正在水平路面上洒水的雾炮车，车内水箱底部出水口面积为50cm²。（g取10N/kg，\rho_水=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，柴油的热值取4.0×10^7J/kg）求：

洒水前雾炮车以10m/s的速度在水平路面上做匀速直线运动，发动机的功率为80kW，此时雾炮车受到的阻力；发动机功率=[X]W上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为1 h。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 30 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一条大型输电线路使用特殊设计的超导材料来传输电流。假设这条输电线路全长200公里，具有极低的电阻，以至于其电阻可以忽略不计。为了满足城市用电需求，这条线路需要传输总功率为32兆瓦的电能。当输电线路的电压维持在200伏特时，请计算通过这条输电线路的电流是多少。

zh: [发动机功率] = [牵引力]*[速度]
en: [Engine Power] = [ Traction]*[ Speed]

question.en:
The total mass of a household car is 1150 kg, and it travels at a constant speed of 72 km/h for [X] km. If the resistance the car encounters is 0.1 times the gravity of the car (g is taken as [X] N/kg), find:
If the efficiency of the car's engine is 25%, and assuming no other energy losses in the engine, the calorific value of gasoline is 4.6 × 10^7 J/kg, what is the mass of gasoline required for the car to travel [X] km in kilograms? The answer to the above problem is [Y] The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 80000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: At a music festival, the stage lighting system requires a large amount of energy to maintain the lighting effects. Suppose the stage lighting equipment includes 100 spotlights, each with a power of 700W. Calculate the total power of the entire lighting system.
question.zh:
家用小汽车总质量为1150kg,以72km/h的速度匀速行驶[X]km,若汽车所受阻力为汽车重力的0.1倍,(g取[X]N/kg)求:
若该汽车热机的效率为25%,如果不考虑热机其它的能量损失,汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg,则该汽车行驶[X]km需要的汽油质量为多少千克?上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 80000 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个音乐节上，舞台灯光系统需要大量的能量以保持灯光效果。假设舞台上的灯光设备包括100盏聚光灯，每盏灯的功率为700W。计算整个灯光系统的总功率。

zh: [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [所需汽油的质量]*[汽油的热值]
[牵引力做的功] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]*[热机效率]
[路程] = [牵引力做的功]/[牵引力]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ required mass of gasoline]*[ gasoline calorific value]
[ work done by traction force] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]*[ thermal efficiency]
[ distance traveled] = [ work done by traction force]/[traction force]

Given that the calorific value of the gas is q=4.2×10^7 J/kg, and the specific heat capacity of water is c=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). Question: If the heat needed is provided by the gas stove, how many kilograms of gas need to be burned? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  time is 1 h。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 90 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A circuit consists of a wire connecting a power supply and a resistor. If the resistance of the circuit is 1.5Ω and the power supply provides a voltage of 39.0V, calculate the current flowing through the wire.
question.zh: 小明家需要将50kg､[X]的水加热到50℃做为生活用水，他利用效率为50%的煤气灶烧热水时，已知煤气的热值q=4.2×10^7kg，水的比热容为c=4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C)。求：若这些热量靠煤气灶提供，需要燃烧多少千克煤气？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为1 h。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 90 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一个电路由一根导线连接电源和一个电阻。如果该电路的电阻为1.5Ω，而电源提供的电压为39.0V，请计算导线中流过的电流是多少？

zh: [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [煤气的热值]*[需要燃烧煤气的质量]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]*[煤气灶的效率]

[初温] = [末温] - [水温升高的度数]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of gas] = [ calorific value of gas]*[ mass of gas required for combustion]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gas]*[ efficiency of gas stove]
[The degree of water temperature increase] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [The degree of water temperature increase]

question.zh: 小明在学习了有关电学的知识后，利用一只标有“220V40W”的白炽灯提出了以下几个问题，请你作出解答：[X]度电可以让这只灯泡正常工作多少小时？额定功率|P|40|W（等价于40×10^{-3}kW）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数煤的质量的值为2 kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 100 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一家公司正在建造一个新的太阳能光伏电站。为了确保电站能够产生足够的电力，他们咨询了工程师，并获得了安装太阳能电池板所需要的总面积。如果每块太阳能电池板的面积为2平方米，公司计划铺设的电池板总数为2700000块。请问，这个太阳能电站所占的总面积是多少平方米？

question.en: The resistance value of the heating element in the electric kettle remains unchanged, with its main parameters as shown in the table below. (The specific heat capacity of water c = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)). Find: Rated Voltage220VCapacity1.5LHeating Power1210WInsulation Power88W When in heating mode, the electric kettle works normally [X], how much electrical energy is consumed? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter diesel calorific value is 3.3×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 4000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a remote area, a power company is setting up new high-voltage transmission lines to deliver electricity from the power plant to the city center. The design voltage for these transmission lines is 279,000 volts. Question: To ensure transmission efficiency, what should the power company set as the operating voltage for the transmission lines, in volts?
question.zh: 电热水壶发热电阻阻值不变，其主要参数如表所示，（水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J/（kg⋅℃）），求：额定电压220V容量1.5L加热功率1210W保温功率88W在加热状态下，电热水壶正常工作[X]，消耗的电能是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数柴油的热值的值为3.3×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 4000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个偏远地区，某电力公司正在架设新的高压输电线路，以便将电能从发电厂输送到城市中心。该输电线路的设计电压为279,000伏。问题：为了保证输电效率，该电力公司需要设定输电线路的工作电压为多少伏？

zh: [工作时间] = [消耗的电能]/[加热功率]
en: [ working time] = [Consumed electric energy]/[ heating power]

question.en:
After learning thermodynamics, two students designed an experiment to determine the calorific value of liquefied gas. They took [X] of water and placed it in a pot, using a thermometer to measure the initial temperature of the water as 20°C, and read the liquefied gas meter at 12.563 m^3. Then, they used the liquefied gas to heat the water. When the thermometer reading reached 80°C, the liquefied gas meter read 12.560 m^3 (c=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C)). 
The heat absorbed by the water during the experiment, Q. The mass of the water is [X].
The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  time t is 1 s。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 200000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Question: In an experiment, a rocket travels along a straight line in a vacuum at a constant speed. Given that the speed of the rocket is 6500 meters per second, if the rocket departs from the starting point and lands after 4 seconds, calculate the total distance the rocket travels.
question.zh:
学习热学知识后，两位同学设计了一个测定液化气热值的实验，取[X]水放入锅中，用温度计测得水的初始温度为20℃，读出液化气表的示数为12.563m^3，然后用液化气给水加热当温度计的示数为80℃时，液化气表的示数为12.560m^3（c=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃））
实验过程中水吸收的热量Q。水的质量为[X]上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间t的值为1 s。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 200000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 题目：在一个实验中，一辆火箭以恒定的速度在真空中沿直线飞行。已知火箭的速度为6500米/秒，如果这辆火箭从起点出发，经过4秒后着陆，请计算火箭飞行的总距离。

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
en: [ temperature change of water]=[Final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ temperature change of water])

question.en: Xiaocong's family lives in a newly constructed rural demonstration village. His father brought back a set of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) stoves before the year-end. The calorific value of LPG is 3.5×10^7 J/kg, and only 60% of the heat released during combustion is absorbed by the water. How much heat in Joules does water with a mass of [X] and an initial temperature of 20°C need to be heated to 100°C? How many grams of LPG need to be burned? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  volume of natural gas is 0.021 m^3。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1 - y * 10 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An engineer designed an electric machine that needs to maintain a stable current while operating. The machine is powered by direct current with a rated voltage of 12V. During normal operation, the machine consumes a power of 50.4W. Please calculate the current of the machine during normal operation.
question.zh: 小聪同学的家住在新农村建设示范村里，他父亲年前拉回了一套液化石油气灶具.液化石油气热值为3.5×10^7J／kg，燃烧放出的热量只有60％被水吸收.将质量为[X]，初温为20℃的水加热到100℃，水需要吸收热量是多少J？需燃烧液化石油气多少g？水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数天然气体积的值为0.021 m^3。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1 - y * 10的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一位工程师设计了一台电动机器，要求它在工作时能够保持稳定电流。机器的电源为直流电，并且额定电压为12V。在正常工作状态下，机器消耗的功率为50.4W。请计算该机器正常工作时的电流是多少。

zh: [水温升高的温度]=[末温]-[初温]
[液化石油气实际放出的热量] = [所需液化石油气的质量]*[液化石油气的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [效率]*[液化石油气实际放出的热量]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[Final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ actual heat released by liquefied petroleum gas] = [ required mass of liquefied petroleum gas]*[ calorific value of liquefied petroleum gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ efficiency]*[ actual heat released by liquefied petroleum gas]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

arguments.en_name: actual heat released by liquefied petroleum gas

question.en:
Energy conservation, emission reduction, green environmental protection, and new energy vehicles have become the direction of future automotive development. Some parameters for a certain model of pure electric vehicle are as follows:

Empty vehicle mass: 1380 kg  
Maximum power: 100 kW  

Tire and ground total contact area: 0.032 m^2  
Maximum speed: 120 km/h  

Battery capacity: 42 kW·h  
Maximum range: 260 km  

Assuming there is only the driver in the car, with a mass of [X], the car travels at a constant speed of 60 km/h for 36 km, consuming 9 kW·h of electricity. The resistance received by the car is 0.05 times the car's total weight. Assuming g = 10 N/kg, find:  
What is the work done by the electric vehicle's traction force? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  final temperature is 70 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 3000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An astronaut traveled from Earth to the Moon in a spaceship. The spaceship's trajectory is a straight line directly from the Earth's surface to the Moon's surface. The average distance from Earth to the Moon is known to be 384,400,000 meters. During the flight, the astronaut conducted scientific observations of space, and when the spaceship was 230,320,000 meters away from the Moon, the astronaut detected a rare space particle for the first time. What is the distance, in meters, from the astronaut to the Earth's surface at that moment?
question.zh: 节能减排，绿色环保，新能源汽车成为未来汽车发展的方向。某种型号纯电动汽车的部分参数如表： 空车质量 1380kg 最大功率 100kW 轮胎与地面总接触面积 0.032m^2 最高时速 120km/h 电池容量 42kw。h 最大续行里程 260km 假如汽车上只有司机一人，质量为[X]，汽车以60km/h的速度匀速行驶36km，耗电9kW•h，汽车所受的阻力为汽车总重的0.05倍。g=10N/kg，试问： 电动汽车牵引力所做的功是多大？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数最终温度的值为70 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 3000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 某宇航员乘坐宇宙飞船进行了一次从地球到月球的旅行。这艘宇宙飞船的航线是从地球表面直接飞往月球表面，假设是条直线。已知从地球到月球的平均距离为384,400,000米。在飞行过程中，这位宇航员在途中对空间进行了科学观测，当宇宙飞船距离月球还有230,320,000米时，宇航员第一次检测到了一种罕见的空间粒子。那么问：宇航员此时距离地球表面的距离是多少米？

zh: [电动汽车的牵引力] = [电动汽车牵引力所做的功]/[行驶距离]
[电动汽车受到的阻力] = [电动汽车的牵引力]
[电动汽车的重力] = 20.0*[电动汽车受到的阻力]
[电动汽车总质量] = [电动汽车的重力]/[重力加速度]
[司机质量] = [电动汽车总质量] - [空车质量]
en: [ electric vehicle's traction force] = [ work done by the electric vehicle's traction]/[ distance traveled]
[Resistance encountered by the electric vehicle] = [ electric vehicle's traction force]
[ electric vehicle's gravitational force] = 20.0*[Resistance encountered by the electric vehicle]
[ total mass of the electric vehicle] = [ electric vehicle's gravitational force]/[ acceleration due to gravity]
[ driver mass] = [ total mass of the electric vehicle] - [ empty vehicle mass]

question.en:
When fuel is applied, some problems may exist, such as incomplete combustion and the released heat not being fully utilized. Xiao Ming's family utilizes the heat of natural gas to heat 50 kg of water from [X]℃ to 100℃ each day, consuming 0.6 kg of natural gas daily. Find: (The calorific value of natural gas q = 3.5×10^7 J/kg, specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)) 

How much heat is needed per day for his family? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 8000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: What is the current volume of water in cubic meters in a large reservoir where the water height reaches 20 meters and the entire area of the reservoir is 7,160,000 square meters?
question.zh:
燃料被应用的时候也会有一些问题存在，比如不一定能完全燃烧，放出的热量不能完全利用等。小明家一天利用天然气的热量相当于把50kg的水从[X]℃加热到100℃，每天消耗0.6kg。求：(天然气的热值q=3.5×10^7J/kg，水的比热容4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃))
则他家一天需要消耗多少热量?上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数汽油的热值的值为4.5×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 8000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个大型水库中，水的高度达到20米，整个水库的面积为7160000平方米。水库中当前的水量是多少立方米？

zh: [水吸收的热量] = [天然气放出的热量]
[水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水的温度变化量]
en: [ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by natural gas]
[ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [Final temperature] - [ temperature change of water]

question.en:
Xiao Yang's water heater contains 5 kg of water, the temperature of the water in the heater decreases from 40°C to [X]. [Specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)] 

How much heat is released by the water in the electric heater during this process? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  volume of water is 20 L。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an experiment, scientists accelerate a special particle by connecting a particle accelerator to a voltage source. It is known that the kinetic energy of the particle increases by 1.16 million electronvolts (eV) when passing through the accelerator, and the charge of the particle is 2 elementary charges (i.e., 2e). Question: How much voltage does the voltage source need to provide in order for the particle's kinetic energy to reach the required value?
question.zh:
小阳家的热水器内装有质量为5kg的水，该热水器中水的温度从40℃降低到[X]。[水的比热容4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)]
电热器内的水在这一过程中放出的热量是多少?上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的体积的值为20 L。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个实验中，科学家通过将一台粒子加速器连接至一台电压源，对某种特殊粒子进行加速。已知该粒子经过加速器时，其动能增加了116万电子伏特（eV），并且电荷量为2个基本电荷（即2e）。问：为了使粒子的动能达到所需值，电压源需要提供多少电压？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水放出的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[最终温度] = [初始温度] - [水的温度变化量]
en: [ temperature change of water] = [Heat released by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] - [ temperature change of water]

question.en: With the development of the national economy, cars have become part of the household. A sedan travels at a constant speed on a flat road surface, covering 82.8 km in 1 hour, consuming [X] liters of gasoline. If 30% of the heat released by the complete combustion of this gasoline is used to drive the car and perform useful work, and the calorific value of the gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg, with a density of 0.6×10^3 kg/m^3, find: the amount of heat released by the complete combustion of the gasoline; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  initial temperature of water is 20 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 40000000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An astronaut needs to walk around the outside of a space station to inspect equipment while on a mission. His stride length is 1 meter, and he maintains a constant speed. If the astronaut takes 62,000,000 steps along the outside of the space station, how many meters does he cover?
question.zh: 随着国民经济的发展，汽车已走进家庭。一辆小轿车以某一速度在平直路面上匀速行驶82.8km用时1h，消耗汽油[X]L．若用这些汽油完全燃烧放出的热量有30%用来驱动汽车做有用功，所用汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg，密度为0.6×10^3kg/m^3，求：这些汽油完全燃烧放出的热量；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的初温的值为20 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 40000000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一个宇航员在空间站执行任务期间，需要绕空间站外部行走一圈以检查设备。他的步长为1米，并且保持匀速运动。如果宇航员沿着空间站的外部走了62000000步，他完成了多少米的行走距离？

zh: [汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
[汽油的体积] = [汽油的质量]/[汽油的密度]
en: [ gasoline's mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]/[Gasoline's calorific value]
[ gasoline's volume] = [ gasoline's mass]/[ gasoline's density]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
Students in a physics interest group heated 100 kg of water using a coal stove, while they plotted a graph showing the change in water temperature over time during the heating process, as shown in the figure. If [X] kg of coal was completely burned in 6 minutes, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), with the calorific value of coal being approximately 3×10^7 J/kg, find:
The heat produced by the complete combustion of coal; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a physics experiment, Xiaoming uses an ohmmeter to measure the resistance in a resistance box. He finds that when the knob of the resistance box is set to a specific position, the reading on the ohmmeter is 40 MΩ. What is the resistance value of the resistance box at this setting?
question.zh:
某物理兴趣小组的同学，用煤炉给100kg的水加热，同时他们绘制了如图所示的加热过程中水温随时间变化的图线。若在6min内完全燃烧了[X]的煤，水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），煤的热值约为3×10^7J/kg．求：
煤完全燃烧产生的热量；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一次物理实验中，小明用欧姆表测量一个电阻箱中的电阻值。他发现，当电阻箱的旋钮位置设置为某一特定档位时，欧姆表的读数为40 MΩ。请问此时电阻箱的电阻值是多少？

zh: [煤的质量] = [煤完全燃烧产生的热量]/[煤的热值]
en: [ mass of coal] = [Heat produced by complete combustion of coal]/[ calorific value of coal]

arguments.en_name: Heat produced by complete combustion of coal

question.en:
When heating water with a gas stove, 4 kg of water with an initial temperature of 25℃ is heated to [X]℃, burning a total of 0.06 m^3 of gas, assuming the gas burns completely. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃) and the calorific value of the gas is approximately 4.2×10^7 J/m^3, find:  
How much heat is absorbed by the water? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Heating value of straw coal is 2.4×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 40000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Question: A car is traveling along a straight highway. It is known that the car's speed remains at 72 kilometers per hour, and the car has traveled for a total of 30 hours from the starting point. Please calculate the total distance traveled by the car.
question.zh:
用煤气灶烧水时，把质量为4kg、初温为25℃的水加热到[X]℃，共燃烧了0.06m^3煤气，设煤气完全燃烧。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃），煤气的热值约为4.2×10^7J/m^3，求：
水吸收的热量是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数秸秆煤的热值的值为2.4×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 40000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 题目：一辆汽车沿着笔直的公路行驶。已知汽车的速度保持为72公里/小时，且汽车从起点开始共行驶了30小时。请计算汽车行驶的总距离。

question.en:
When using bituminous coal to heat water, 10 kg of water is heated from 20℃ to [X]℃, burning 1.4 kg of bituminous coal. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), and the calorific value of bituminous coal is approximately 3×10^7 J/kg. Determine:  
What is the heat absorbed by the water? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of liquefied gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 80000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: At a large construction site, a batch of steel needs to be transported to another construction location. This batch consists of 5000 steel beams, each with a mass of 928 kg. Please calculate the total mass of this batch of steel.
question.zh:
用烟煤烧水时，将10kg的水从20℃加热到[X]℃，燃烧了1.4kg的烟煤，水的比热熔是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，烟煤的热值约为3×10^7J/kg，试求：
水吸收的热量是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数液化气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 80000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在某个大型建筑工地上，需要运输一批钢材到另一个施工地点。这批钢材共由5000根钢梁组成，每根钢梁的质量为928千克。请计算这批钢材的总质量。

zh: [水的温差] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温差]
en: [ temperature difference of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature difference of water]

question.en:
On February 17, 2020, two "Y-20 flight tickets" became viral among WeChat friends, and "Y-20 flight tickets pay tribute to medical heroes" topped the Weibo trending list, receiving countless likes from netizens. If the Y-20 flies at a constant horizontal thrust F at a speed of 720 km/h for 1 hour and fully burns 4800 kg of aviation kerosene, given that the mechanical power of the airplane engine is [X]W and the heat value of aviation kerosene is 4×10^7J/kg, find:  
The horizontal thrust F obtained by the engine; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Operation Time is 50 min。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1 - y * 100 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: On a distant planet, there is a special ore known as Starstone. This ore has a density of 8000 kg/m³. At the center of this planet, a large deposit of Starstone has been discovered, with exploration data indicating that its volume is approximately 2000 m³. Please calculate the total mass of this Starstone deposit.
question.zh:
2020年2月17日，两张“运-20机票”在微信朋友刷屏，“运-20飞机票致敬白衣战士”登上微博热搜榜，无数网友点赞．若运-20在高空中飞行时在恒定的水平推力F的作用下，以720km/h的速度沿水平方向匀速航行1h，需要完全燃烧航空煤油4800kg，已知飞机发动机的机械功率是[X]W，航空煤油的热值为4×10^7J/kg。试求：
发动机获得的水平推力F；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数工作时间的值为50 min。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1 - y * 100的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个遥远的星球上，有一种特殊的矿石，被称为星辉石。这种矿石的密度为8000 kg/m³。在这个星球的中心发现了一个巨大的星辉石矿藏，探测数据显示其体积约为2000 m³。请计算该星辉石矿藏的总质量。

zh: [发动机功率] = [水平推力F]*[飞机速度]
en: [Engine Power] = [ Horizontal Thrust F]*[ Aircraft Speed]

question.en:
Mi Gui is a traditional delicacy of Sanming (as shown in the figure), and its preparation involves steaming soaked rice. When using a coal stove to steam the rice over water, 4 kg of water is heated to boiling, and the water temperature increases by [X]℃. Given c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), q_coal = 3×10^7 J/kg, find in this process:
If the efficiency of the coal stove in heating the water is 15%, calculate the heat released by the burning of coal; the answer to the aforementioned question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Rated voltage is 220 V。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 700000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A ship is sailing at a constant speed on the sea. It departs from a port, journeys continuously, and bypasses a sea area, finally reaching the destination dock. The ship maintains a straight course throughout its voyage, and the total distance from departure to the destination is 44,100 kilometers. Calculate the total straight-line distance between the port and the destination dock in meters.
question.zh:
米粿是三明的传统美食（如图），制作时需先将浸泡过的米蒸熟。当用煤炉隔水蒸米时，将质量为4kg的水加热到沸腾，水温升高了[X]℃，已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，q_煤=3×10^7J/kg，求此过程中：
煤炉加热水的效率为15%，煤燃烧放出的热量；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数额定电压的值为220 V。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 700000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一艘船在海上航行，以恒定速度行驶。它从港口出发，经过不断的航行和绕过一片海域，最终到达目的地码头。船在航行过程中始终保持直线路线，并且从出发到到达目的地的总距离为44100公里。求港口和目的地码头之间的总直线距离，用米表示。

zh: [水吸收的热量] = [效率]*[煤燃烧放出的热量]
[水温升高的度数] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
en: [ Heat absorbed by water] = [ Efficiency]*[ Heat released by coal combustion]
[Temperature increase of water] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([ Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Mass of water])

question.en:
The highly anticipated 2022 World Cup was held in Qatar, with the Lusail Stadium built by Chinese companies serving as both a national symbol of Qatar and a testament to the overseas strength of China's infrastructure capabilities. As shown in the figure, a mobile concrete mixer truck from the Chinese infrastructure team has a mass of 11t and when loaded with 5t of concrete, the total contact area between the tires and the ground is 0.8m^{2}. When the truck is traveling at a constant speed of 72km/h on a straight road, the engine's output power is 128kW. (g is 10N/kg, fuel heat value is q=4×10^7J/kg) Calculate:
When the mixer truck is in motion, the engine efficiency is 40%. How many kilograms of fuel are needed for driving at a constant speed of 72km/h [X]? When the mixer truck is traveling at a constant speed, the traction force it experiences is 6400N. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  water volume is 1.5 L。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 70000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a scientific experiment, researchers use an electric heater to transfer heat to an iron block with a mass of 15 kilograms. Given that the specific heat capacity of iron is 450 J/(kg·°C), if the initial temperature of the iron block is 20°C and the final temperature is 60°C, calculate the amount of heat transferred to the iron block by the electric heater.
question.zh:
万众瞩目的2022年世界杯在卡塔尔举办，由中国企业建造的卢塞尔体育场既是卡塔尔的国家名片，也是中国基建实力在海外的强大体现。如图是中国基建队的一辆质量为11t的流动式混凝土搅拌车，当装有5t的混凝土时，轮胎与地面接触的总面积为0.8m^{2.}车以72km/h的速度在平直公路上匀速行驶时，发动机的输出功率为128kW。（g取10N/kg，燃油的热值取q=4×10^7J/kg）求：
搅拌车行驶时发动机的效率为40%，以72km/h的速度匀速行驶[X]，需要消耗多少千克燃油？搅拌车在匀速行驶时，其受到的牵引力为6400N上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的体积的值为1.5 L。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 70000 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一场科学实验中，研究人员使用电加热器向一块质量为15公斤的铁块传递热量。已知铁的比热容为450 J/(kg·℃)。如果铁块的初始温度是20℃，最终温度为60℃，试计算电加热器传递给铁块的热量是多少？

zh: [燃料完全燃烧放出的热量] = [燃油的热值]*[燃油质量]
[有用功] = [发动机效率]*[燃料完全燃烧放出的热量]
[行驶距离] = [有用功]/[牵引力]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of fuel] = [ heat value of fuel]*[ fuel mass]
[Useful work] = [ engine efficiency]*[ heat released by complete combustion of fuel]
[ driving distance] = [Useful work]/[ traction]

arguments.zh_name: 燃料完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of fuel

question.en:
When boiling water using a gas stove, 2.2 kg of water is heated from an initial temperature of 20℃ to [X], with a total of 45 g of natural gas burned (assuming complete combustion of the natural gas). Given that the calorific value of natural gas is 4.4×10^7 J/kg and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), calculate:
The heat absorbed by the water; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  time is 5 min。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 7000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a certain circuit, two resistors R1 and R2 are connected in series. It is known that the total resistance of the circuit is 40000 Ω, and the resistance value of R1 is 800 Ω. Find the resistance value of R2.
question.zh:
用燃气灶烧水时，把2.2kg初温为20℃的水加热到[X]，共燃烧了45g天然气（假设天然气完全燃烧）．已知天然气热值为4.4×10^7J/kg，水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）．在此过程中，试计算：
水吸收的热量；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为5 min。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 7000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 某电路中，两个电阻 R1 和 R2 串联连接。已知电路的总电阻为 40000 Ω，其中 R1 的电阻值为 800 Ω。求 R2 的电阻值。

zh: [水温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水温度变化量]
en: [ change in water temperature] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ change in water temperature]

question.en:
With the improvement of people's living standards, more and more families are using "water-based underfloor heating" for heating. Its principle is to use hot water with a temperature not exceeding 60°C as the heat medium, circulating in pipes buried in the filling layer below the ground, heating the entire floor, and supplying heat to the interior through thermal conduction (as shown in the figure).

During a certain period, the mass of water circulating in a room is [X], with an inlet temperature of 55°C and an outlet temperature of 40°C. How much heat is released by the water to the external environment during this period? [The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C)] The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of dry firewood is 1.2×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 90000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a large-scale reservoir, a water volume measurement is being conducted. It is known that the reservoir has a length of 4500 meters, a width of 2000 meters, and an average depth of 3 meters. Please calculate the amount of water stored in the reservoir and determine if it matches the normal capacity of the reservoir.
question.zh:
随着人们生活水平的提高，越来越多的家庭采用“水地暖”进行取暖．其原理是以温度不高于60℃的热水为热媒，在埋置于地面以下填充层中的管道内循环流动，加热整个地板，通过地面以热传递方式向室内供热的一种供暖方式(如图所示)．

某房间一段时间内循环流动的水质量为[X]，进水温度为55℃，出水温度为40℃．这段时间里水向外界放出多少热量？[水的比热容为4.2×10^3
J/(kg·℃)]上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数干木柴的热值的值为1.2×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 90000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个大规模的水库中，正在进行一次水量测量。已知水库的长度为4500米，宽度为2000米，平均深度为3米。请计算水库中储存的水量，并判断是否与该水库的正常容量相匹配。

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[进水温度]-[出水温度]
[水的质量] = [水放出的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
en: [ change in water temperature]=[ inlet water temperature]-[ outlet water temperature]
[ mass of water] = [The heat released by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ change in water temperature])

question.en:
As shown in the figure, an iron ball with a mass of [X] slides down a frictionless incline from a height of 2.3m and then collides with a metal block on the horizontal ground. It is assumed that 20% of the mechanical energy of the iron ball is converted into internal energy during the collision and is fully absorbed by the iron ball itself (c_iron = 0.46×10^3J/(kg•℃)). It is also assumed that throughout the entire motion, there is no friction between the iron ball and the contact surface, and air resistance is negligible.  
What is the work done by gravity on the iron ball during its descent to the bottom of the incline in joules? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 60 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Xiaoming is conducting a circuit experiment. He has a resistor with a resistance of 5 ohms and a battery with a voltage of 18.5 volts. After connecting the circuit, Xiaoming wants to know what the current flowing through this circuit is. According to Ohm's Law, what is the magnitude of the current?
question.zh:
如图，质量为[X]的铁球从高为2.3m的斜面顶端无摩擦下滑后，撞击到水平地面上的金属块。假设撞击时铁球的机械能有20%转化成内能，并全部被自己吸收（c_铁=0.46×10^3J/（kg•℃），假设铁球在整个运动过程中与接触面无摩擦、不计空气阻力）。
求铁球下滑到斜面底端的过程中，重力做功多少J？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 60 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 小明正在进行电路实验，他有一个电阻为5欧姆的电阻器和一个电压为18.5伏特的电池。接上电路后，小明想知道这个电路中流过的电流是多少。根据欧姆定律，请问电流的大小是多少？

zh: [铁球的重力] = [重力做的功]/[下滑高度]
[铁球的质量] = [铁球的重力]/[重力加速度]
en: [ weight of the iron ball] = [work done by gravity]/[ sliding height]
[ mass of the iron ball] = [ weight of the iron ball]/[ gravitational acceleration]

question.en: As a new energy product, solar cells are gradually being widely used. A certain solar panel can receive solar radiation energy of approximately [X] J in a few hours. If this energy is completely generated by the combustion of coke with a calorific value of 3.0×10^7 J/kg, what is the mass of coke required? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  final temperature is 100 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 90000000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A high-speed train is traveling at a constant speed, and after one hour, it has just passed through a tunnel that is 25,200 kilometers long. What is the length of the tunnel?
question.zh:
太阳能电池作为一种新能源产品，逐渐得到广泛应用。某太阳能电池板在几小时内可得到的太阳辐射能约为[X]J。
若这些能量由热值为3.0×10^7J/kg的焦炭完全燃烧产生，则所需焦炭的质量是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数末温的值为100 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 90000000 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一辆高速列车以恒定速度行驶，经过一个小时后，它刚好穿过了一座长达25,200公里的隧道。问这座隧道的长度是多少？

zh: [太阳辐射能] = [所需焦炭质量]*[焦炭的热值]
en: [ solar radiant energy] = [ required coke mass]*[Coke calorific value]

question.en:
Use a stone slab with a mass of 3 kg to grill meat; the temperature of the stone slab decreases from 80℃ to 50℃. Find the heat released by the stone slab, Q_released. [c_stone = 0.9×10^3 J/(kg·℃)]
(Supplement: The temperature change of the stone slab is [X];) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of coal is 3×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 6000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an electrical engineering project, engineers are designing a high-voltage transmission line to support the power needs of a city. The transmission line's voltage needs to comply with the city's safety standards while ensuring power supply efficiency. It is known that the transmission line voltage must be 99 kilovolts. What is the measured line voltage obtained by the engineers during the design process?
question.zh:
用质量为3千克的石板烤肉，石板温度从80℃降低到50℃，求这一过程中石板放出的热量Q_放。[c_石=0.9×10^3J/(kg·℃)]
 （补充：石板的温度变化量是[X]; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数煤的热值的值为3×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 6000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个电力工程项目中，工程师正在设计一个高压输电线路，以支持一座城市的电力需求。输电线路的电压需要符合城市安全标准，同时满足供电效率。已知输电线路的电压必须是99千伏。在设计过程中，工程师测量得到的线路电压是多少？

zh: [石板的温度变化量] = [石板放出的热量]/([石板的比热容]*[石板的质量])
en: [ slate temperature change] = [ heat released by slate]/([ specific heat capacity of slate]*[Slate mass])

question.en: A small truck with a mass of 3t has a rated power of 100kW and is loaded with 6t of sand and gravel. The truck travels at a constant speed of 36km/h on a straight road with a power of [X] for 10 minutes, consuming 1.2kg of gasoline. Given g = 10N/kg and neglecting air resistance, what is the efficiency of converting the heat released by the complete combustion of gasoline into the work done by the truck's traction force? (Keep the result to one decimal place) (Supplement: Power is [X]; Time is 10×60s; The heat released from the complete combustion of gasoline is 5.4×10^7J; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1 - y * 20000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an electron experiment, students need to measure the resistance value of an unknown resistor. To perform the measurement, the experimental equipment includes a constant voltage source and a high-precision ammeter. When the voltage source is applied to the resistor, the ammeter displays a current reading of 0.016 A. Meanwhile, the voltmeter measures a voltage of 248.96 V. Based on these measurements, calculate the resistance value of the unknown resistor.
question.zh: 质量为3t的小型载重汽车，额定功率为100kW，车上装有6t的砂石。汽车以36km/h的速度在平直公路上以[X]的功率匀速行驶了l0min，消耗汽油1.2kg。g取10N/kg，不计空气阻力，试问：汽油完全燃烧放出的热量转换为汽车牵引力的做功的效率为多少？（结果保留一位小数） （补充：功率是[X]; 时间是10×60s; 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量是5.4×10^7J; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1 - y * 20000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个电子实验中，学生需要测量一个未知电阻器的阻值。为了进行测量，实验设备包括一个恒定电压源和一个高精度电流表。当电压源施加到电阻器时，电流表显示的电流读数为0.016 A。同时，电压表测得电压为248.96 V。根据这些测量数据，计算该未知电阻器的电阻值。

zh: [牵引力做的功] = [效率]*[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]
[功率] = [牵引力做的功]/[时间]
en: [ work done by traction] = [ efficiency]*[ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]
[Power] = [ work done by traction]/[ time]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
A rescue volunteer team is conducting a sea rescue drill using a life raft. Volunteers A and B place a life raft with a mass of 100 kg (including a gasoline engine, etc.) on the horizontal deck of the ship, where the contact area between the life raft and the deck is 4 m^2. It is known that the masses of both A and B are 50 kg each. (g = 10 N/kg, ρ_{seawater} = 1.0×10^3 kg/m^[X], q_{gasoline} = 4.6×10^7 J/kg)

The drill location is 50 km away from the nearest shore. The life raft is lowered from the ship into the sea, and A and B board the life raft, which travels at a constant speed along the sea surface. The resistance on the life raft is always 0.2 times the total weight at the start of the journey, and 20% of the heat released from the complete combustion of the gasoline is converted into mechanical energy to propel the life raft forward. If the engine contains [X] kg of gasoline, calculate and explain whether A and B can safely reach the shore. (Supplementary: The traction force is 400 N; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  initial temperature is 20 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 40000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Next to a large reservoir, there is a plan to build a new amusement park. The park will include a large artificial lake for visitors to enjoy boating. To ensure sufficient water capacity, it's necessary to calculate the volume of the artificial lake. In the design, the lake is shaped as a rectangular prism with a length of 170 meters and a width of 60 meters. If the water depth of the artificial lake is 5 meters, what is the volume of the water in the lake?
question.zh:
某救援志愿小组利用救生筏开展海上救援演练。甲、乙2名志愿者将质量为100kg的救生筏（内含汽油发动机等）放在轮船的水平甲板上，救生筏与甲板接触面积为4m^2，已知甲、乙两人的质量均为50kg。（g=10N/kg，ρ_{海水}=1.0×10^3kg/m^[X]，q_{汽油}=4.6×10^7J/kg）
演练地点离最近的海岸50km，将救生筏从轮船放入海中，甲、乙两人乘坐救生筏，救生筏沿海面匀速行驶，救生筏受到的阻力始终为开始出发时总重力的0.2倍，汽油完全燃烧放出热量的20%转化为推动救生筏前进的机械能。若发动机装有汽油[X]kg，请通过计算说明甲、乙能否安全抵达海岸。 （补充：牵引力是400N; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数初温的值为20 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 40000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个大型水库旁，计划修建一个新的游乐园。游乐园将包含一个巨大的人工湖供游人划船游玩。为了确保足够的水容量，需要计算人工湖的体积。在设计中，人工湖被设计成一个长方体形状，长为170米，宽为60米。请问，如果人工湖的水深为5米，湖中的水体积是多少？

zh: [有效利用的机械能] = [牵引力]*[行驶最大距离]
[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [有效利用的机械能]/[热效率]
[汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
en: [ effectively utilized mechanical energy] = [Traction]*[ maximum driving distance]
[ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ effectively utilized mechanical energy]/[ thermal efficiency]
[ gasoline quality] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
Classifying and utilizing waste reasonably can protect the environment and turn waste into treasure. Under certain conditions, 1 ton of classified waste can "extract" [X] kg of fuel oil, with a calorific value of 3.0×10^7 J/kg. Find: [c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)]
How much heat energy is released when the fuel oil is completely combusted? The answer to the question above is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  the temperature increase of water is 25 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 70000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a large particle accelerator, scientists are studying the characteristics of particle collisions. In one experiment, they successfully propelled a stream of high-energy ions at a speed of 30,000,000 meters per second through a designated acceleration path. Both ends of the path are connected to a special charging device. As the ions pass through the device, a total charge of 5.6×10^9 coulombs is instantaneously transferred within the device. What is the total amount of charge that passes through the device during the entire experiment?
question.zh:
合理分类和利用垃圾可以保护环境、变废为宝。在一定条件下，1t分类后的垃圾能“榨”出[X]kg燃料油，若燃料油的热值为3.0×10^7J/kg。求：[c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)]
燃料油完全燃烧能释放多少热量？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水温升高的温度的值为25 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 70000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个大型粒子加速器中，科学家们正在研究粒子碰撞的特性。在一次实验中，他们成功地让一束高能离子以每秒30,000,000米的速度运动，通过设定的加速路径。路径的两端连接着一个特殊的充电装置。随着离子通过装置，一个总电荷为5.6×10^9库仑的电荷在装置中瞬间完成转移。请问，在整个实验过程中，通过该装置的总电荷量是多少？

zh: [燃料油的质量] = [燃料油完全燃烧能释放的热量]/[燃料油的热值]
en: [The mass of fuel oil] = [ the heat released by the complete combustion of fuel oil]/[ the calorific value of fuel oil]

arguments.en_name: the calorific value of fuel oil

arguments.zh_name: 燃料油完全燃烧能释放的热量
arguments.en_name: the heat released by the complete combustion of fuel oil

question.en: After learning about thermodynamics, Xiaoming knows the specific heat of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃). He wants to estimate the amount of heat needed by his family for boiling water and cooking every day. Therefore, Xiaoming carefully recorded the time his family spends boiling water, cooking rice, and frying dishes. He converted this into boiling water time, equivalent to boiling 30 kg of water from 20℃ to boiling point every day. If the calorific value of ordinary coal is 3×10^7 J/kg, theoretically, how many kilograms of coal does Xiaoming's household need per day for boiling water and cooking? (Supplementary information: final temperature is [X]; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  volume of crude oil is 158.99 L。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1 - y * 200 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a small home studio, Linda is using a fan and a desk lamp to aid her painting work. It is known that the fan has a rated power of 20.5 watts, while the desk lamp has a rated power of 12.3 watts. What is the total power of the electrical appliances for the entire studio when these two devices are used simultaneously?
question.zh: 小明学习了热学的有关知识后，知道水的比热是4.2×10^3焦/（千克•℃），他想估算一下自己家每天烧水、做饭需要的热量，于是小明仔细记录了他家每天烧水、煮饭、炒菜需要的时间，并把它折算成烧水时间，相当于每天将30千克20℃的水烧开．如果普通煤的燃烧值为3×10^7焦/千克，从理论上讲小明家每天烧水做饭需要多少千克煤？ （补充：末温是[X]; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数原油体积的值为158.99 L。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1 - y * 200的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个小型家庭工作室中，琳达正在使用一个电风扇和一个台灯来帮助她的绘画工作。已知电风扇的额定功率为20.5瓦，而台灯的额定功率为12.3瓦。当这两个电器同时使用时，整个工作室的电器总功率是多少？

zh: [煤燃烧放出的热量] = [所需煤的质量]*[煤的燃烧值]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤燃烧放出的热量]
[水升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水升高的温度]
en: [Heat released by coal combustion] = [ mass of coal required]*[ calorific value of coal]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [Heat released by coal combustion]
[ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature rise of water]

question.en:
In recent years, China has been vigorously promoting new energy vehicles. A certain electric car (as shown in the figure) has traveled at a constant speed of 60 km/h for 80 km, with a traction force of [X], consuming 18 kWh. Please answer the following question:

There is a gasoline car with the same shape and gravity as the electric car, which travels 80 km at a speed of 60 km/h on the same road surface. Its efficiency is 25%. How many kilograms of gasoline does it need to consume? ( ) The calorific value of gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  final temperature is 70 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 700 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A heavy object is lifted into the air through a pulley system with a mechanical efficiency of 80%. Given that the force applied on the rope is 3580.0 N, find the gravitational force on the object.
question.zh:
近几年来，我国大力推广新能源汽车，某款电动汽车(如图所示)以60km/h的速度匀速行驶了80
km，所受的牵引力为[X]，耗电18kW·h，请解答下列问题:


有一款与它外形、重力均相同的汽油车，在相同路面上以60km/h的速度行驶80km，其效率为25%，需要消耗多少千克汽油?（）汽油的热值为4.5×10^7J/kg上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数最终温度的值为70 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 700 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一个重物通过滑轮系统提升到空中，滑轮的机械效率为80%。已知施加在绳子上的拉力为3580.0N，求重物的重力。

zh: [汽油需要释放的能量] = [汽油的热值]*[汽油质量]
[有用功] = [汽油车效率]*[汽油需要释放的能量]
[电动汽车牵引力做的功] = [有用功]
[牵引力] = [电动汽车牵引力做的功]/[行驶距离]
en: [ energy released by gasoline] = [ calorific value of gasoline]*[ mass of gasoline]
[Useful work] = [ efficiency of gasoline car]*[ energy released by gasoline]
[ work done by traction force of electric vehicle] = [Useful work]
[ traction force] = [ work done by traction force of electric vehicle]/[ travel distance]

question.en: In order to protect the environment, we should vigorously advocate the use of clean energy. To increase the temperature of 20kg of water from 20℃ to [X]. [c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃), q_natural_gas=4×10^7J/m^3] How much natural gas needs to be burned if using a gas water heater with 60% thermal efficiency? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Time is 0.1 s。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1 - y * 90 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Xiao Ming and Xiao Hua participated in a sprint race on the playground. They started at the same time from the starting line and ran towards the finish line at the same speed along a straight path. After running 20 meters, Xiao Hua accidentally fell, but he immediately got up and continued running at the original speed. Shortly after Xiao Ming reached the finish line, Xiao Hua also reached the finish line. Given that Xiao Ming ran 54.25 meters from start to finish, how far is it from the place where Xiao Hua fell to the finish line?
question.zh:
为了保护环境，我们应大力提倡使用清洁能源。欲使20kg、20℃的水温度升高[X]。[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），q_{天然气}=4×10^7J/m^3]
如果使用热效率为60%的天然气热水器，需要燃烧多少天然气？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为0.1 s。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1 - y * 90的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 小明和小华在操场上进行了一次短跑比赛。他们从起点同时出发，以相同的速度沿着一条直线跑向终点。小华在跑完20米后，不小心摔倒了，但他在摔倒后立即站起来继续奔跑，并以原来的速度继续跑。在小明到达终点后不久，小华也到达了终点。已知小明从起点到终点跑了54.25米，那么从小华摔倒的地方到终点有多远？

zh: [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[需要燃烧的天然气体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]*[热水器的热效率]
[水温升高的度数] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
en: [ Heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ Heat value of natural gas]*[ Volume of natural gas required for combustion]
[ Heat absorbed by water] = [ Heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]*[ Thermal efficiency of the water heater]
[Temperature increase of the water] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([ Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Mass of water])

question.en: The efficiency of an engine is an important indicator of a car's economic performance. If a certain brand of car travels at a constant speed of 25 m/s on a flat road for 10^5 m, with the power of the work done to overcome resistance being [X], and the fuel consumption being 5 kg (the calorific value of the gasoline is q=4.0×10^7 J/kg), find: the resistance experienced by the car; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 200 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Problem: A large factory decides to install a new electric motor to improve production efficiency. The rated power of the electric motor is 140,000 watts. Under normal operating conditions, how much power does this motor need to consume to complete its work tasks?
question.zh:
发动机的效率是汽车经济性能的重要指标。若某品牌汽车在平直公路上以25m/s的速度匀速行驶10^5m，汽车克服阻力做功的功率为[X]，耗油量为5kg。（汽油的热值为q=4.0×10^7J/kg）求：
汽车所受的阻力；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 200 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 题目：一家大型工厂决定安装新的电动机以提高生产效率。该电动机的额定功率为140,000瓦。在正常运行情况下，这台电动机需要消耗多少功率来完成其工作任务？

zh: [牵引力] = [阻力]
[功率] = [牵引力]*[速度]
en: [ tractive force] = [Drag]
[ power] = [ tractive force]*[ velocity]

question.en:
Given that a certain domestic car consumes 8 liters of gasoline every 100 km, and the density of gasoline is 0.71×10^3 kg/m^3 with a calorific value of 4.6×10^7 J/kg. Find: 
How much heat is generated when [X] kg of gasoline is completely burned; the answer to the question above is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a circuit experiment, scientists used a superconducting material capable of withstanding enormous currents to create a current-carrying wire. When the wire is fully energized, the maximum current it can reach is 40,000,000 amperes. In this experiment, what is the current the wire can withstand when the circuit reaches its maximum current?
question.zh:
已知某国产轿车每行驶100km消耗汽油8L，汽油的密度为0.71×10^3kg/m^3、热值为4.6×10^7J/kg．求：
[X]kg汽油完全燃烧时所产生的热量是多少；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个电路实验中，科学家使用了一个能够承受巨大电流的超导材料来制造电流导线。当导线完全通电时，能够达到的最大电流是40,000,000安培。请问这个实验中，当电路达到最大电流时，导线能够承受的电流是多少？

zh: [汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧产生的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [ the mass of gasoline] = [ the heat produced by complete combustion of gasoline]/[The calorific value of gasoline]

question.en:
The following table is the nameplate of the XX brand electric kettle. During a certain use, the electric kettle heats 1.5 kg of water from 25°C to 100°C, consuming 5.25×10^5 J of electrical energy. [c_water=4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)]. In this usage process, calculate:
If the electric kettle operates normally for 5 minutes, how much electrical energy is consumed? The rated power of the electric kettle is [X]. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of natural gas is 7.0×10^7 J/m^3。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 400 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: The surface temperature of a star is one of the important indicators studied by astronomers. Suppose an astronomer observes a distant star, whose spectral properties indicate that its surface temperature complies with Wien's displacement law, resulting in a peak wavelength of 19.35 nanometers. Please calculate the surface temperature of this star, rounded to the nearest thousand.

下表是××牌电水壶的铭牌。某次使用过程中，该电水壶把1.5kg的水从25℃加热到100℃，消耗的电能为5.25×10^5J。[c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)]。求这次使用过程中：

question.en: Xiaolan's home has installed a solar water heater with a capacity of [X]. After filling it with water, the temperature of the water rises from 20℃ to 40℃ after 5 hours of sunlight exposure. Given [ρ_water = 1×10^3 kg/m^3, c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), q_{natural gas} = 3×10^7 J/m^3], if these calories were provided by a gas stove with an efficiency of 20%, how many m^3 of natural gas would need to be burned? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  area of a single landing gear base is 1×10^{-2} m^2。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 2 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a simple circuit, the power supply voltage is 27V, and the resistance is 2Ω. What is the current flowing through this circuit? (Assume all components are ideal.)
question.zh:
小兰家安装了一台容积为[X]的太阳能热水器，加满水后，经5h阳光照射，水温由原来的20℃升高到40℃。则，[ρ_水=1×10^3kg/m^3，c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），q_{天然气}=3×10^7J/m^3]
若这些热量由效率为20%的燃气灶燃烧天然气来提供，则需要燃烧多少m^3的天然气？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数单个起落架底面积的值为1×10^{-2} m^2。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 2 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个简单的电路中，电源电压为27V，电阻为2Ω。求通过这个电路的电流是多少？（假设所有组件都是理想的）。

[水吸收的热量] = [天然气需放出的热量]*[燃气灶效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的度数]*[水的比热容])
[体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]

question.en:
In modern home decoration, some bathrooms use gas water heaters to provide hot water. Xiao Fang's home has a gas water heater installed. The temperature of the water entering the heater is known to be 10°C, and the temperature of the hot water when bathing is set to 40°C. If Xiao Fang uses [X]m^3 of hot water for each shower, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), calculate:  

If 70% of the heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas is absorbed by the water, how many m^3 of natural gas are consumed? (The calorific value of natural gas q = 4×10^7 J/m^3) The density of water is 1000 kg/m^3. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  electrical voltage is 220 V。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 10 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an experiment, Xiao Ming used a wire to create a closed circuit. In the circuit, Xiao Ming measured the voltage of the power supply to be 5V, and the current through the circuit to be 18.18A. What is the resistance of the wire that Xiao Ming used?
question.zh:
现代家庭装修中有些浴室使用燃气热水器提供热水，小芳家安装了燃气热水器。已知水进入热水器前的温度是10℃，洗澡时热水器输出热水的温度设定为40℃；如果小芳洗一次澡用热水[X]m^3，水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）。求：
若天然气完全燃烧释放热量的70%被水吸收，需要消耗多少m^3的天然气？（天然气的热值q=4×10^7J/m^3）水的密度为1000kg/m^3上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数电源电压的值为220 V。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 10 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一次实验中，小明使用导线制作了一个闭合电路。在电路中，小明测量到电源的电压为5V，而通过电路的电流为18.18A。请问小明使用的导线的电阻是多少？

zh: [温差]=[热水温度]-[冷水温度]
[天然气完全燃烧释放的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[消耗天然气的体积]
[水升温所需的热量] = [天然气完全燃烧释放的热量]*[热水器效率]
[热水的质量] = [水升温所需的热量]/([水的比热容]*[温差])
[热水的体积] = [热水的质量]/[水的密度]

[ heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of consumed natural gas]
[ heat required for water temperature increase] = [ heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas]*[ efficiency of water heater]
[mass of hot water] = [ heat required for water temperature increase]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ temperature difference])
[ volume of hot water] = [mass of hot water]/[ density of water]

question.en:
A student calculates the thermal efficiency of boiling water using natural gas at home. He puts [X] of water into the kettle and measures the water temperature as 25°C. At standard atmospheric pressure, after heating the water to 100°C, he notes that 0.0525 m^3 of natural gas has been consumed. The calorific value of natural gas is approximately q=4.0×10^7J/m^3. Question: 

If an electric kettle with a rated power of 1800W is used to boil the same [X] of water, for how many seconds must it be powered at a minimum? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C). The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 400 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A high-voltage transmission line supplies power to an area of a city through a transformer. It is known that the output voltage of this transformer is 45,000 volts, and the total power demand of the area is 30,375,000 watts. What is the current supplied to this area by the transmission line after passing through the transformer?
question.zh:
某同学计算他家天然气烧水的热效率。他将[X]的水入烧水壶中，并测出水温为25℃。在一个标准大气压下，把水刚加热到100℃时，测出消耗天然气0.0525m^3。天然气热值约为q=4.0×10^7J/m^3。求：
若用额定功率为1800W的电热壶来烧开这[X]的水，至少要通电多少秒?水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数煤气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 400 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一条高压输电线通过一个变压器给城市的一个区域供电。已知该变压器的输出电压为45,000伏特，而需要供电的区域总功率需求为30,375,000瓦。那么输电线经过变压器后，将向这个区域提供多少电流？

zh: [水升高的温度]=[水的末温]-[水的初温]
[水吸收的热量] = [电热壶额定功率]*[通电时间]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature of water]-[Initial temperature of water]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ rated power of electric kettle]*[ electrification time]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
Over the forty years since the reform and opening-up, China's economy has rapidly developed, and people's living standards have significantly improved. Cars have entered ordinary households. Xiaoming's car consumes 12.5L of gasoline to travel 100 kilometers, taking 1.5 hours. Assuming the gasoline is completely combusted, the actual output power of the engine is [X]. (The calorific value of gasoline is q=4.5×10^7J/kg, ρ_{gasoline}=0.8×10^3kg/m^3)

Please complete the following question:
What is the work output by the engine during the 100-kilometer drive? (Supplement: the power is [X];) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 10000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a deep-sea exploration mission, a high-tech submarine needs to withstand the immense pressure from the deep sea. It is known that a section of the submarine has an area of 50 square meters, and at this depth, the water pressure is 2,300,000 newtons per square meter. Please calculate the total pressure exerted on this part of the submarine in newtons.
question.zh:
改革开放四十年来，我国经济迅速发展，人民生活水平显著提高，小汽车已进入寻常百姓家。小明家的汽车行驶一百公里消耗汽油12.5L，用时1.5h，假设汽油完全燃烧，发动机的实际输出功率为[X]。（汽油热值为q=4.5×10^7J／kg，ρ_{汽油}=0.8×10^3kg／m^3）
请完成下列问题：
汽车在行驶一百公里过程中，发动机输出的功？ （补充：功率是[X]; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 10000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在某一深海探索任务中，高科技潜艇需要抵抗来自深海的巨大压力。已知潜艇的一个部分面积为50平方米，而在这个深度水的压强为每平方米2300000牛顿。请计算潜艇这一部分承受的总压力为多少牛顿。

zh: [功率] = [发动机输出的功]/[时间]
en: [ power] = [engine output work]/[ time]

question.en: Xiaoqiang uses natural gas to boil water, knowing that the calorific value of natural gas is 8.4×10^7J/m^3 and [X] is used. To boil the water, 4.2×10^7J of heat needs to be absorbed. Question: If the heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas is all used to do external work, how high can a 20N object rise? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  final temperature is 65 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In space exploration, an astronaut needs to depart from the International Space Station to repair equipment located on the surface of a near-Earth asteroid. According to calculations, the direct distance between the asteroid and the International Space Station is 114,500,000 meters. The astronaut, without any obstructions, pilots a special space shuttle traveling at a speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour. How far does the astronaut need to travel to reach the asteroid?
question.zh:
小强用天然气烧水，已知天然气的热值是8.4×10^7J/m^3，用掉了[X]，烧开这些水需要吸收4.2×10^7J的热量，求：
如果所完全燃烧天然气放出的热量全部对外做功，能使20N的物体上升多高？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数末温的值为65 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在太空探索中，某个宇航员需要从国际空间站出发，修复位于一颗近地小行星表面的设备。据测算，该小行星与国际空间站的直线距离为114,500,000米。宇航员在没有障碍物阻挡的情况下，驾驶专用太空穿梭机以每小时28,000公里的速度飞行。请问这位宇航员需要飞行多远才能到达小行星？

zh: [对外做的功] = [物体上升的高度]*[重力]
[天然气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [对外做的功]
[消耗天然气的体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [ work done externally] = [height of the object's rise]*[ gravity]
[ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ work done externally]
[ volume of natural gas consumed] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]

question.en:
Students from the "Environmental Group" conducted an energy consumption test on the newly installed gas water heater at Xiaoming's home as part of their research activities (as shown in Figure A). They first filled the water heater with [X] of water, then connected the infrared heat sensor linked to a computer to the water heater's tank before starting the heating process. The computer displayed a graph of the water temperature inside the heater over time, as shown in Figure B [The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C), and the calorific value of natural gas is approximately 4×10^7 J/m^3]. Calculate:

If all the heat absorbed by the water can be used to do work for a car, calculate the maximum distance the car can travel when pulled by a force. The water temperature increased by 50°C (Supplement: The pulling force is 1000 N.) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  contact area between a single tire and the ground is 0.3 m^2。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an experiment, researchers need to transmit current through a wire to drive a large electromagnet. In the experimental setup, the electromagnet requires stable transmission of strong current to ensure it produces sufficient magnetic field strength for specific scientific research. The resistance of the wire is 0.25 ohms, while the connected power supply provides a voltage of 1975 volts. Please calculate the transmitted current.
question.zh:
“环境小组”的同学在研究性活动中对小明家新装的燃气热水器（如图甲）进行了耗能测试，他们先将热水器注满[X]的水，再将与计算机相连的红外线热传感器接入热水器水箱后，开始加热。计算机显示出热水器中水温度随时间变化的图象如图乙所示[水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅°C)，天然气的热值约为4×10^7J/m^3]。求：

如果水吸收的热量能全部用来对小轿车做功，若以的动力牵引，轿车可行驶的最远路程。水温升高了50°C （补充：牵引力是1000N; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数单个轮胎与地面接触面积的值为0.3 m^2。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个实验中，研究人员需要通过一根导线传输电流以驱动大型电磁铁。在实验设置中，电磁铁需要稳定传输强大的电流以确保其产生足够的磁场强度用于特定的科学研究。导线的电阻是0.25欧姆，而连接的电源提供了1975伏特的电压。请计算传输的电流是多少？

zh: [小轿车牵引力做的功] = [牵引力]*[轿车可行驶的最远路程]
[水吸收的热量] = [小轿车牵引力做的功]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ work done by car traction] = [ traction]*[The longest distance a car can travel]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ work done by car traction]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
Human ancestors created fire by friction, marking a new chapter in human civilization. One method of making fire by friction involves inserting a sharpened stick into a hole in a wooden board and applying force to the stick by moving the bow back and forth. The stick rotates within the hole in the board, causing friction between the board and the stick, converting mechanical energy into internal energy. The heat remains concentrated within the hole, not easily dissipating, and raises the temperature of the stick's tip. When the temperature reaches about 260°C, the stick begins to combust. Since wood is a poor conductor of heat, the heated thickness is minimal, and the mass of the heated portion of the stick is only 0.25 grams. Given that it takes 1.0 second to move the bow back and forth once, the bow's length is s = 0.25 meters, the force exerted by a person pulling the bow is [X] Newtons, the specific heat capacity of the wood is c = 2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the room temperature is 20°C, the question is:
If 25% of the work done by overcoming friction is absorbed by the tip of the stick, how much can the temperature of the tip of the stick be increased in 1 second?
The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Calorific value of diesel is 3×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 40 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a circuit experiment, the physics teacher asked the students to measure the current passing through the conductor. It is known that the resistance of the circuit is 5.0Ω, and the voltage is 720V. Please calculate the magnitude of the current passing through this circuit.
question.zh:
人类的祖先钻木取火，为人类文明揭开了新的一页．钻木取火的一种方法是将削尖的木棒伸到木板的洞里，用力压住木棒来回拉动钻弓．木棒在木板的洞里转动时，板与棒互相摩擦，机械能转化为内能，而热集中在洞内，不易散发，提高了木棒尖端的温度，当达到约260℃时木棒便开始燃烧．因木头是热的不良导体，故受热厚度很薄，木棒受热部分的质量只有0.25克．已知：来回拉一次钻弓需1.0秒，钻弓长为s=0.25米，人拉钻弓的力为[X]牛顿，木头比热容c=2×10^3焦／(千克·℃)，室温为20℃，问：
人克服摩擦力做功使机械能转化为内能，若其中有25％被木棒尖端吸收，则1秒内可使木棒尖端温度提高多少℃?
上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数柴油的热值的值为3×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 40 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个电路实验中，物理老师要求学生测量通过导体的电流。已知该电路的电阻为5.0Ω，电压为720V。请计算通过这个电路的电流大小。

zh: [被木棒尖端吸收的热量] = [木头比热容]*[木棒受热部分质量]*[木棒尖端温度升高值]
[1秒内克服摩擦力做的功] = 4.0*[被木棒尖端吸收的热量]
[拉力] = [1秒内克服摩擦力做的功]/(2*[位移])
en: [ Heat absorbed by the tip of the wooden rod] = [ Specific heat capacity of wood]*[ Mass of the heated part of the wooden rod]*[Temperature increase at the tip of the wooden rod]
[ Work done overcoming friction within 1 second] = 4.0*[ Heat absorbed by the tip of the wooden rod]
[ Tension] = [ Work done overcoming friction within 1 second]/(2*[ Displacement])

Work done overcoming friction within 1 second
Mass of the heated part of the wooden rod
