The value of the unrelated parameter  volume of water is 20 L。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 20000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An electrical engineer is designing a circuit that requires 12V applied at both ends to generate enough resistance to protect sensitive components from overload. Assuming the current flowing through the circuit is 0.0000015A, calculate the resistance value needed for the circuit.
question.zh: 国庆期间，小明一家去户外野炊。他们使用木炭作为燃料，已知这种木炭的热值是2.8×10^7J/kg，水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），求：[X]木炭完全燃烧放出的热量是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的体积的值为20 L。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 20000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一名电气工程师正在设计一个电路，该电路需要在两端施加12V的电压，以便产生足够的电阻来保护敏感元件免受过载。假设该电路中流过的电流为0.0000015A，请计算该电路需要的电阻值是多少？

zh: [木炭的质量] = [木炭完全燃烧放出的热量]/[木炭的热值]
en: [ mass of charcoal] = [ heat released by complete combustion of charcoal]/[Charcoal calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 木炭完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of charcoal

question.en:
Recently, many cities in China have introduced shared electric vehicles, greatly facilitating travel for local residents and visitors, and they are well received by the citizens. Electric vehicles have advantages such as being environmentally friendly and having high energy conversion efficiency, and countries are promoting this green mode of transportation. As shown in the figure, a certain brand of electric vehicle has its partial parameters listed in the table. Please answer:

The electric vehicle drove [X] km on the highway in 1.5 hours. What was the speed of the vehicle on the highway? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 10000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an experiment, a research team is testing a new industrial hydraulic press which can transmit force to the object to be compressed through a piston. It is known that the cross-sectional area of the piston is 2 square meters. When the hydraulic press is powered on, the liquid begins to push the piston and applies pressure to it. Assuming the hydraulic press is applying maximum force to compress an extremely hard metal block, calculate the force exerted by the hydraulic press on the metal block, given that the pressure per unit area exerted by the hydraulic press is 51111 Newtons per square meter.
question.zh:
最近我国许多城市出现了共享电动汽车，极大的方便了当地市民和所到游客的出行，深受市民们的喜爱。电动汽车具有绿色环保、能量转化效率高等优点，各国都在推广这种绿色的交通工具。如图是某品牌的电动汽车，它的部分参数如表所示。请回答：


该电动汽车在高速公路行驶[X]km，用时1.5h，汽车在高速公路行驶的速度是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 10000 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一次实验中，某研究小组正在测试一台新型工业液压机，该液压机能够通过一根活塞将力传递到待压缩的物体上。已知活塞的横截面积为2平方米，当液压机通电运转时，液体开始推动活塞并对其施加压力。假设液压机正在施加最大力以压缩一个极为坚硬的金属块，请计算液压机对金属块施加的力为多少，条件是液压机单位面积上的压力为51111牛顿每平方米。

zh: [行驶路程] = [汽车行驶速度]*[行驶时间]
en: [ travel distance] = [Car speed]*[ travel time]

question.en: A certain middle school supplies hot water for students, using a boiler to heat 200 kg of water from 25°C to 100°C, burning [X] of a certain type of coal. (q_coal = 3.5×10^7 J/kg) Find: How much heat is released by the complete combustion of anthracite? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  initial temperature is 20 °C。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 500000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An environmental engineer is hired by a city to design a massive solar farm to provide power to the city. This solar farm will consist of a series of solar panels, which will be installed on a wide open area. It is known that each solar panel occupies 4 square meters, and through optimized design, the maximum installation density can be achieved without affecting performance. To provide sufficient power for the entire city, the engineer calculates that the total area required for the solar panels is 2,790,000,000 square meters. What is the total area required for this solar farm?
question.zh: 某中学为学生供应开水，用锅炉将200kg的水从25℃加热到100℃，燃烧了[X]的某种煤。（q_煤=3.5×10^7J/kg）求： 无烟煤完全燃烧放出多少热量？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数初温的值为20 °C。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 500000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一位环保工程师受雇于一个城市，以设计一个巨大的太阳能农场来为城市提供电力。这个太阳能农场将由一系列的太阳能电池板组成，这些电池板将被安装在一个面积宽阔的空地上。已知每块太阳能电池板占地4平方米，并且通过优化设计可以达到最大的安装密度而不影响性能。为了给整个城市提供足够的电力，工程师计算出所需的太阳能电池板总占地面积为2790000000平方米。请问这个太阳能农场所需的总面积是多少？

zh: [煤的质量] = [无烟煤完全燃烧放出的热量]/[煤的热值]
en: [coal mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of anthracite]/[ calorific value of coal]

arguments.zh_name: 无烟煤完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of anthracite

question.en:
A household gas water heater heats 100 kg of water from 20℃ to 70℃, consuming a volume of [X] of natural gas (assuming complete combustion of the natural gas). The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), and the calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/m^3.
Find:
The heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas; the answer to the above problem is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  final temperature is 35 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 70000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: The shape of a large reservoir can be approximately regarded as a rectangular cuboid with a base area of 1,400,000 square meters. After a period of rainfall, the water level in the reservoir rose to its maximum capacity. Please calculate the maximum volume of the reservoir if the water level rise is 40 meters.
question.zh:
某家庭用燃气热水器将质量为100kg，温度为20℃的水加热到70℃，消耗天然气体积为[X]（假设天然气完全燃烧）。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），天然气的热值为4.2×10^7J/m^3。
求：
天然气完全燃烧放出的热量；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数末温的值为35 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 70000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 某个大型水库的形状可以近似看作一个长方体，其底面积为1400000平方米。经过一段时间的降水，水库的水位上升到了满库容。请计算水库的最大容积，如果水库的水位上升高度为40米。

zh: [消耗天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [ volume of natural gas consumed] = [ heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[Calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: As shown in the figure, it is the latest prototype of a driverless car. During automatic driving, the car uses radar sensors and laser rangefinders to understand the surrounding traffic conditions. The car travels uniformly in a straight line along a level road at a speed of 72 km/h for 8 km, consuming gasoline [X]. Assuming complete combustion of the fuel and an engine efficiency of 30%, calculate the useful work done by the car's engine during this motion. (The density of gasoline is 0.8×10^3 kg/m^3, and the calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg.) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  time is 1 h。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 10000000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a scientific experiment, a researcher aims to test the energy output of a new type of fuel. He used a specially designed combustion chamber that can completely burn 100 grams of the new fuel. It is known that the fuel's heat of combustion is 15,600 J/g. To verify the accuracy of the heat of combustion calculation, the researcher measured the total energy produced during the combustion process. Please calculate the total energy released in this combustion process and determine whether the researcher's measurement result is accurate.
question.zh:
如图所示，是最新一款无人驾驶汽车原型图。汽车自动驾驶时使用雷达传感器，以及激光测距器来了解周围的交通状况。该款车以72km/h的速度沿一段水平公路匀速直线行驶了8km时，消耗汽油[X]。假设燃油完全燃烧，汽油机的效率为30%，那么，在这段运动过程中(汽油的密度为0.8×10^3kg/m^3，汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg)，求：
该汽车发动机做的有用功是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为1 h。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 10000000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一次科学实验中，某研究人员希望测试一种新型燃料的能量输出。他使用了一个专门设计的燃烧室，该燃烧室能够完全燃烧100克的新型燃料。已知该燃料的燃烧热为15,600 J/g。为了验证燃烧热的计算是否准确，研究人员测量了燃烧过程中产生的总能量。请计算此次燃烧过程所释放的总能量，并判断研究人员的测量结果是否准确。

zh: [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [发动机做的有用功]/[汽油机效率]
[汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
[汽油体积] = [汽油质量]/[汽油密度]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ useful work done by the engine]/[ efficiency of the gasoline engine]
[ gasoline mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]
[ gasoline volume] = [ gasoline mass]/[gasoline density]

arguments.en_name: useful work done by the engine

arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
A kettle contains 3 kg of water at 40°C. It is heated to boiling using a gas stove, consuming [X] m^3 of natural gas. The calorific value of natural gas is known to be 8.0×10^7 J/m^3, and the atmospheric pressure is 1 standard atmosphere. Find:  
How much heat is released by the complete combustion of the natural gas? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  mass of water is 100 kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 60000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A factory has a large electric motor used to drive the machinery on the production line. The motor is connected to a power supply with a rated voltage of 400V and operates normally. During operation, the current of the motor is measured to be 1000A. Please calculate the output power of the motor.
question.zh:
水壶里装有3kg、40℃的水，用天然气炉具将其加热至沸腾，烧开这壶水消耗的天然气是[X]m^3，已知天然气的热值为8.0×10^7J/m^3，大气压强为1标准大气压。求：
天然气完全燃烧放出多少热量？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的质量的值为100 kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 60000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一个工厂拥有一台大型电动机，用于驱动生产线上的机械设备。电动机接到了额定电压为400V的电源上，并正常运转。在运行过程中，测得该电动机的电流为1000A。请计算该电动机的输出功率。

zh: [消耗天然气的体积] = [天然气完全燃烧释放的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [ volume of natural gas consumed] = [ heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[Heating value of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧释放的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en:
Zhi Zhi and her family had a picnic outdoors, using charcoal to boil water. There is 5 kg of water in the pot, which is heated from 18℃ to [X]℃. It is known that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃). During this process, 500g of charcoal is used, and the calorific value of charcoal is 3.36×10^7J/kg. Calculate:
The amount of heat absorbed by the water during this process. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of crude oil is 4.4×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 100000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: During an international long-haul flight, a supersonic airliner takes off from Beijing to New York, with a flight path as a straight line. It is known that the airliner's average flying speed is 1350 kilometers per hour, and the distance from Beijing to New York is 8120 kilometers. Question: If the airliner maintains the average speed, what is the flying distance in meters?
question.zh:
智智和家人在郊外野餐，用木炭烧水。锅内装有5kg水，把水从18℃加热至[X]℃，已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）。在这个过程中用掉500g的木炭，已知木炭的热值3.36×10^7J/kg。求：
在这个过程中水吸收的热量。上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数原油热值的值为4.4×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 100000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一次国际长途飞行中，一架超音速客机从北京起飞前往纽约，飞行路径为一条直线。已知这架客机的平均飞行速度为1350千米每小时，而从北京到纽约的距离为8120千米。问：这架客机在保持平均速度的情况下，飞行的距离是多少米？

zh: [水升高的温度差] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水升高的温度差]
en: [ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[Final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature rise of water]

question.en: In August 2022, the 25th Shandong Provincial Games will be held in Rizhao City. To provide convenience for heating food for athletes, teachers and students from a school made 100 electric ovens using resistance wires. When one of the electric ovens works under 220V voltage, the heat generated per minute is [X]. Assume that the resistance of the resistance wire of the electric oven does not change with temperature. Find the electric power of this electric oven when it works under 220V voltage; (Supplement: the time is 60s; ) The answer to the above problem is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  mass of alcohol (g) is 80 g。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1 - y * 20 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Question: An electric vehicle charging station needs to charge several electric vehicles every day. Assuming that each electric vehicle's battery needs to be charged with 22,000.0 coulombs of electric charge to be fully charged, if the charging station completed charging for two electric vehicles today, how many coulombs of electric charge were transmitted by the station today in total?
question.zh: 2022年8月，第25届山东省运动会将在日照市举行。为给运动员加热食品提供方便，某校师生用电阻丝自制了100台电烘箱。其中一台电烘箱在220V电压下工作时，每分钟产生的热量为[X]。假设电烘箱的电阻丝的电阻不随温度变化。求这台电烘箱在220V电压下工作时的电功率； （补充：时间是60s; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数酒精的质量(g)的值为80 g。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1 - y * 20的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 题目：一个电动汽车充电站每天需要为若干辆电动车充电。假设每辆电动车的电池需要充入22,000.0库仑的电量才能充满，如果今天充电站共为两辆电动车完成充电，请问今天充电站共传输了多少库仑的电量？

zh: [电流做的功] = [时间]*[电烘箱的电功率]
en: [ work done by current] = [ time]*[Electric oven power]

question.en:
In a certain area, local abundant solar energy is used for power generation to supply production and daily life. It is known that in a period of time, the solar energy received per second on an area of 1m^2 perpendicular to sunlight is 500J. As shown in the figure, the angle between the sunlight and the horizontal plane is [X]°, and the solar panel with an area of 4m^2 is placed vertically. The solar panel converts solar energy directly into electrical energy with an efficiency of 20%. Calculate the electrical energy obtained through this solar panel in 1 minute.
(Supplement: The solar panel with an area of 4m^2 receives solar energy at a rate of 1000J/s per second;) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 2000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A train departs from city A and travels at a constant speed, reaching its destination city B after 3 hours. If the train's speed is 36,000 meters per hour, find the distance from city A to city B.
question.zh:
某地区利用当地丰富的太阳能资源发电，供生产生活使用。
已知在一段时间内，垂直于太阳光的1m^2面积上每1秒接收的太阳能为500J，如图所示，太阳光与水平面夹角为[X]°，面积为4m^2的太阳能电池板竖直放置。太阳能电池板将太阳能直接转化为电能的效率为20%。求1分钟内通过该太阳能电池板获得的电能。
 （补充：4m^2太阳能电池板每秒接收到的太阳能是1000J/s; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 2000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一辆火车从城市A出发，以恒定速度行驶，经过3小时到达目的地城市B。如果火车的速度为36,000米每小时，求城市A到城市B的距离。

zh: [总太阳能量] = [获得的电能]/[转化效率]
[时间] = [总太阳能量]/[4m^2太阳能电池板每秒接收到的太阳能]
en: [ total solar energy] = [ electrical energy obtained]/[ conversion efficiency]
[ time] = [ total solar energy]/[The solar energy received per second by a 4m^2 solar panel]

arguments.zh_name: 4m^2太阳能电池板每秒接收到的太阳能
arguments.en_name: The solar energy received per second by a 4m^2 solar panel

question.en: As shown in the figure, this is an energy conversion diagram of a gasoline engine in operation. If [X] kg of gasoline is consumed, how much kinetic energy can be obtained? (The calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg.) (Supplement: The efficiency of the gasoline engine is 15%; the answer to the above question is [Y].) The value of the unrelated parameter  Final temperature is 100 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: At a large concert, the stage lighting system uses an advanced set of lighting equipment. The entire lighting system consists of multiple lamps with the same power output, using a total of 100 lamps. If each lamp has a power of 862 kilowatts, calculate the total power of the entire lighting system in watts.
question.zh:
如图所示，是小轿车汽油机工作时的能量转化示意图，消耗[X]kg汽油，可获得的动能是多少？（汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg）
 （补充：汽油机的效率是15%; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数末温的值为100 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个大型音乐会中，舞台照明系统使用了一套先进的灯光设备。整个照明系统由多台功率相同的灯具组成，共使用了100台灯具。如果每台灯具的功率为862千瓦，计算整个照明系统的总功率是多少瓦？

zh: [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [小轿车获得的动能]/[汽油机的效率]
[汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [ Heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ Kinetic energy acquired by the sedan]/[Efficiency of the gasoline engine]
[ Mass of gasoline] = [ Heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ Calorific value of gasoline]

arguments.en_name: Kinetic energy acquired by the sedan

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: Heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
In the circuit, an electrical appliance marked "220V[X]W" is operating normally. Find:
① The current I passing through the appliance.
② The electricity consumption in kilowatt-hours when the appliance operates for 10 hours. The answer to the above questions is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  air mass is 1200 kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 70000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A train departs from city A and travels at a speed of 100 kilometers per hour, aiming to reach city B, which is 3740 kilometers away. Assuming the train maintains a constant speed and does not stop, how many meters does the train need to travel to reach city B?
question.zh:
在电路中，标有“220V[X]W”字样的用电器正常工作。求：
①通过该用电器的电流I。
②工作10小时，该用电器耗电的度数。上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数空气的质量的值为1200 kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 70000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一辆火车从城市A出发，以每小时100公里的速度行驶，目标是到达3740公里以外的城市B。假设火车保持恒定速度并不停站，请问火车需要行驶多少米才能到达城市B？

zh: [额定功率] = [消耗的电能]/[时间]
en: [Rated power] = [ consumed energy]/[ time]

question.en:
In summer, students like to drink ice water. Xiao Ming puts a bottle of mineral water at 30°C with a volume of [X] mL in the refrigerator for a long time. The temperature of the refrigerator is 4°C. 

How much alcohol in grams must be burned to release an equivalent amount of heat? (The calorific value of alcohol is 3.0×10^7 J/kg. The density of water is 1.0×10^3 kg/m³. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.18×10^3 J/(kg·℃). The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  time is 10 min。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 40 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a track race, athlete A surpassed athlete B. After the race, they checked their results. Athlete A's time was 9.81 seconds, while athlete B's time was 9.82818 seconds. Please calculate the time by which athlete A surpassed athlete B.
question.zh:
夏天，同学们喜欢喝冰水，小明将30℃的一瓶[X]mL的矿泉水放在冰箱的冷藏室很长一段时间，冷藏室的温度为4℃，则：
这些热量相当于燃烧多少g酒精放山的热量？（酒精热值为3.0×10^7J/kg)水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m³水的比热容为4.18×10^3J/(kg·℃)上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为10 min。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 40 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一次田径赛跑比赛中，运动员A超过了运动员B。比赛结束后，两人查看了各自的成绩。运动员A的成绩为9.81秒，而运动员B的成绩为9.82818秒。请计算运动员A超过运动员B的时间。

zh: [温度变化量]=[初温]-[末温]
[水降温放出的热量] = [酒精的热值]*[需要燃烧的酒精质量]
[矿泉水的质量] = [水降温放出的热量]/([水的比热容]*[温度变化量])
[矿泉水体积] = [矿泉水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [Temperature change]=[ initial temperature]-[ final temperature]
[ heat released by water during cooling] = [ calorific value of alcohol]*[ mass of alcohol needed for combustion]
[ mass of mineral water] = [ heat released by water during cooling]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[Temperature change])
[ volume of mineral water] = [ mass of mineral water]/[ density of water]

arguments.en_name: heat released by water during cooling
mass of alcohol needed for combustion

question.en: In order to provide a suitable living environment for the tropical fish in the aquarium, Xiao Qiang uses a "220V 300W" heating rod to heat the water in the tank. When the water temperature rises to the set value of 25℃, the heating rod automatically stops working. When the water naturally cools to 20℃, the heating rod automatically starts heating again, repeating the cycle. Each heating period loses 20% of heat, and the mass of the water in the aquarium is always maintained at 40 kg, with c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃). Under the rated voltage, how many minutes does the heating rod work each time? (Keep one decimal place in the calculation result) (Supplement: efficiency is 1-20%; (heat absorbed by the water) is [X]; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an electrical circuit experiment, researchers used a specially made resistance wire. The length of this resistance wire is 1000 meters, and its cross-sectional area is 0.1 square meters. It is made of a special alloy with very poor conductivity. The resistivity of this alloy is known to be 265.8 Ω·m. Please calculate the resistance value through this resistance wire.
question.zh: 为了让鱼缸内的热带鱼有一个适合的生活环境，小强用一只“220V300W”的加热棒给鱼缸内的水加热。当水温升到设定值25℃时加热棒自动停止工作，待水温自然冷却到20℃时加热棒自动开始加热，周而复始，每次加热期间损失20%的热量，鱼缸内水的质量始终保持为40kg，c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)额定电压下，加热棒每次工作的时间是多少分钟？（计算结果保留一位小数） （补充：效率是1-20%; (水吸收的热量)是[X]; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1000 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个电路实验中，研究人员使用了一根特制的电阻丝。该电阻丝的长度为1000米，截面积为0.1平方米，且由一种导电性能极差的特殊合金制成。已知该合金的电阻率为265.8Ω·m。请计算通过该电阻丝的电阻值。

zh: [加热棒产的热量] = [功率]*[加热时间]
[(水吸收的热量)] = [加热棒产的热量]*[效率]
en: [ heat generated by the heating rod] = [Power]*[ heating time]
[ (heat absorbed by water)] = [ heat generated by the heating rod]*[ efficiency]

arguments.en_name: heat generated by the heating rod

question.en:
Given the data shown in the table below from a certain brand of electric kettle's nameplate, calculate:
Electric kettle capacity 1.5L
Rated voltage 220V
Rated power [X]W
Frequency 50Hz
The current when the kettle is operating normally: the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter volume of water is 50 L。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a special circuit, there is a conductor operating with a constant current. It is known that the total charge transferred by this conductor in 10 seconds is 39,000 coulombs. What is the current of this conductor?
question.zh: 某品牌电热水壶的铭牌上标着如表格所示的数据，求： 电热水壶容量 1.5L 额定电压 220V 额定功率 [X]W 频率 50HZ 该电热水壶正常工作时的电流：上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的体积的值为50 L。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1000 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个特殊的电路中，有一个导体以恒定的电流运行。已知该导体在10秒内传输的电荷总量为39000库仑。请问这个导体的电流是多少？

zh: [额定功率] = [电流]*[额定电压]
en: [rated power] = [ current]*[ rated voltage]

question.en: Excessive exploitation of coal, oil, and natural gas has led humanity to face an energy crisis. In winter, a certain county uses geothermal energy for heating. There is a self-flowing geothermal well in the county with a water temperature of 90°C and a flow rate of 150m^3/h. If this heat is used for heating by a natural gas steam boiler with a thermal efficiency of 90%, how much heat needs to be released by natural gas per hour? (Supplement: the actual effective heat is [X]; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/（kg·℃）。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 6 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A fully loaded supertanker is docked at the port. It is known that the mass of the tanker when empty is 210,000,000.0 kilograms, and the total mass reaches 143,010,000,000.0 kilograms when it is filled with oil. Assuming the density of the loaded oil is 850 kilograms per cubic meter, what is the mass of the loaded oil in kilograms?
question.zh:
煤、石油、天然气的过量开采使人类面临能源危机。某县在冬季利用地热能为用户取暖。县内有一口自喷状态地热井，出水温度为90℃，出水流量为150m^3/h。
这些热量如果用天然气蒸汽锅炉供热，且天然气蒸汽锅炉的热效率为90%，每小时需要天然气释放多少热量？ （补充：实际有效热量是[X]; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/（kg·℃）。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 6 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一艘满载货物的超级油轮正停靠在港口。已知油轮在空载情况下的质量为210000000.0千克，当它装满油后，总质量达到143010000000.0千克。假设装载的油密度为850千克/立方米。问：装载的油的质量是多少千克？

zh: [实际有效热量] = [天然气需要放出的热量]*[锅炉效率]
en: [ actual effective heat] = [ heat released by natural gas]*[Boiler efficiency]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气需要放出的热量

question.en:
On May 6, 2019, the first batch of 30 hydrogen fuel new energy buses were put into use in Liaocheng. Hydrogen fuel has advantages such as being clean, non-polluting, and highly efficient, and is considered the ideal energy source of the 21st century. [c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg°C); q_hydrogen = 1.4×10^8 J/kg) Calculate: 
The heat released from the complete combustion of hydrogen fuel with a mass of [X]; the answer to the above problem is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 40000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a giant circular accelerator, scientists are conducting experiments to observe the behavior of high-energy particles. The accelerator has a length of 5000 kilometers and is designed to circulate particles through a circular track. To reach a sufficient energy level, the required current reaches a staggering 30,000,000 amperes. Considering the materials and structure of the accelerator, calculate the current delivered by the accelerator when operating at full capacity.
question.zh:
2019年5月6日，聊城首批30辆氢燃料新能源公交车投放使用。氢燃料具有清洁无污染、效率高等优点，被认为是21世纪最理想的能源，[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）；q_氢=1.4×10^8J/kg）求：
质量为[X]的氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 40000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个巨型环形加速器中，科学家们正在进行实验以观察高能粒子的行为。该加速器的长度为5000公里，并且设计成可以通过环形轨道循环粒子。为了达到足够的能量水平，所需的电流达到令人惊讶的30,000,000安培。考虑到加速器的材料和结构，请计算加速器在满负荷运行时所输送的电流是多少。

zh: [氢燃料质量] = [氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量]/[氢燃料热值]
en: [ mass of hydrogen fuel] = [ heat released by complete combustion of hydrogen fuel]/[Hydrogen fuel calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of hydrogen fuel

question.en: As shown in the diagram, there is a ladder-type concrete mixer used for construction sites, bridge construction, and other engineering projects. During operation, the mixer processes raw materials into concrete and automatically pours it into the material hopper. Under the drive of the lifting motor, the material hopper ascends along the vertical ladder through the fixed pulley at the top of the ladder to a certain position and then unloads the concrete. Some parameters of this ladder-type mixer are shown in the table below. Find: Model J2M310 Total Mass of the Machine (kg) 2000 Mass of the Empty Material Hopper (kg) 70 Rated Power of the Lifting Motor (kW) 4.5 When the lifting motor is working normally [X], what is the amount of electrical energy consumed? The answer to the above problem is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter original water temperature of the metal block is 92 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 70000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Question: During a long-distance space travel, a spaceship is moving at a constant speed of 2,000 meters per second and needs to travel from Earth to a distant planet. Assume the spaceship is not affected by any gravitational or other external forces, and it does not stop or change its speed midway. If the spaceship's travel time is 943,200 seconds, what is the total distance traveled by the spaceship in meters?
question.zh: 如图是一种用于建筑工地、桥梁施工等工程的爬梯式混凝土搅拌机。工作时，搅拌机将原料加工成混凝土后自动倒入运料斗，在提升电机的带动下，运料斗通过爬梯顶端定滑轮沿竖直爬梯上升到一定位置，然后将混凝土卸下。该爬梯式搅拌机部分参数如表所示，求： 型号 J2M310 整机质量（kg） 2000 空的运料斗质量（kg） 70 提升电机额定功率（kW） 4.5 提升电机正常工作[X]，消耗的电能是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数金属块原来的水温的值为92 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 70000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 题目：在一次长距离太空旅行中，一艘宇宙飞船以2,000米/秒的速度匀速行驶，并需要从地球飞往某个遥远的星球。假设飞船不受任何引力或其他外部力量的影响，并且中途没有停顿或改变速度。若飞船的行驶时间是943200秒，那么飞船行驶的总距离是多少米？

zh: [时间] = [消耗的电能]/[电功率]
en: [ time] = [Consumed electrical energy]/[ electrical power]

question.en: As shown in the figure, a certain model of multifunctional sprinkler truck has an unladen mass of 3t and is equipped with a large capacity water tank with an internal depth of [X]m, and a drainage hole at the bottom with an area of 0.003m^2. When the multifunctional sprinkler truck is moving uniformly on a level ground, the resistance it encounters is constantly 0.08 times the total weight. On one occasion, the truck is fully loaded (filled) and starts from rest on a horizontal surface, during the startup (acceleration) process, the engine consumes 100g of diesel. The measured power of the vehicle's traction force and its instantaneous speed changes over time are shown in Figures A and B respectively. Given g=10N/kg, ρ_water=1.0×10^3kg/m^3, q_diesel=4.0×10^7J/kg, with complete combustion of fuel. Find: When the sprinkler truck is fully loaded, if a negligibly weighted steel sheet is used to block the drainage hole from the outside, what is the minimum external force that must be applied to the steel sheet? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  final temperature is 70 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a circuit experiment, students connected a resistor to a power supply. During the measurement, they found that the current in the circuit was 0.5A, while the voltage of the power supply was 10.0V. Based on this information, calculate the resistance value of the resistor in the circuit.
question.zh:
如图所示为某种型号的多功能洒水车，它空载时的质量为3t，配备了一个内深为[X]m的大容量水箱，底部有一个面积为0.003m^2的放水孔。若多功能洒水车在水平地面上匀速行驶时受到的阻力恒为总重的0.08倍，某次该车满载（装满）后由静止开始在水平面上启动，在启动（加速）过程中，发动机消耗100g柴油。测得汽车牵引力的功率及其瞬时速度随时间的变化情况分别如图甲和图乙所示。已知g=10N/kg，ρ_水=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，q_{柴油}=4.0×10^7J/kg，燃油完全燃烧。求：
该洒水车满载时，若用质量不计的小钢片从外部堵住放水孔，则需对小钢片施加的外力至少是多少N？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数末温的值为70 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 题目：在一个电路实验中，学生们连接了一个电阻与一个电源。在测量过程中，他们发现该电路中的电流为0.5A，而电源的电压为10.0V。根据这些信息，计算该电路中电阻的阻值。

zh: [水对放水孔的压强] = [所需外力]/[放水孔面积]
[水箱内深] = [水对放水孔的压强]/([水的密度]*[重力加速度])
en: [Pressure of water on the drainage hole] = [ required external force]/[ area of the drainage hole]
[ depth inside the water tank] = [Pressure of water on the drainage hole]/([ density of water]*[ gravitational acceleration])

arguments.en_name: Pressure of water on the drainage hole

question.en:
When a hybrid vehicle starts, the internal combustion engine does not work and the battery supplies energy to the wheels. When high-speed driving is required or the battery power is too low, the internal combustion engine starts, which can supply energy to the wheels and charge the battery. In a certain test, the energy stored in the battery is 5×10^7 J, energy is provided by the internal combustion engine, and the vehicle moves at a constant speed of 50 km/h on a horizontal road for 0.5 h, with an average resistance of 1000 N, while the battery energy increases by 22%. In the above test,
the test consumed [X] fuel, with a calorific value of 4.5×10^7 J/kg (assuming the fuel is completely burned), what is the total amount of heat released? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  time is 0.5 h。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a power plant, there is a large transformer responsible for stabilizing and stepping up voltage to supply electricity to a distant city. The primary coil of the transformer receives a voltage of 50,000.0V, and it is measured that the effective output voltage to the secondary coil is 200 times the voltage of the primary coil. What is the output voltage of the transformer’s secondary coil in volts?
question.zh:
某混合动力汽车启动时，内燃机不工作，蓄电池向车轮输送能量，当需要高速行驶或蓄电池电能过低时，内燃机启动，既可以向车轮输送能量，又可以给蓄电池充电．在某次测试中，蓄电池储存的电能为5×10^7J，由内燃机提供能量，汽车以50km/h的速度在水平路面匀速直线行驶了0.5h，所受的平均阻力为1000N，同时蓄电池的电能增加了22%．则在上述测试中．
测试消耗了[X]燃料，燃料的热值为4.5×10^7J/kg（假设燃料完全燃烧），放出的总热量是多少?上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数时间的值为0.5 h。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个发电厂中，有一个大型变压器，负责稳定和升压电压以供电给远距离的城市。该变压器的初级线圈接收到的电压为50000.0V，经测算有效输出给次级线圈的电压是初级线圈电压的200倍。那么，该变压器次级线圈的输出电压是多少伏特？

zh: [燃料质量] = [放出的总热量]/[燃料的热值]
en: [ fuel mass] = [Total heat released]/[ heat value of fuel]

question.en: Xiaohua's family recently bought a new car with a mass of 12t. The total contact area between the car wheels and the ground is 0.12m^2. Over the weekend, Xiaohua's family drove to the countryside, traveling at a constant speed of 72 km/h on a certain section of level road. During this process, the car's output power was 40 kW. Find: If the car consumes [X] liters of gasoline per 100 kilometers, calculate the total heat released by the complete combustion of this gasoline. The calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  fuel volume is 1.5 L。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 400000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a large reservoir, when the water level is normal, the total water storage capacity is 3,000,000,000 cubic meters. Due to several consecutive months of drought, the water level of the reservoir has dropped to 59% of its full capacity. Question: What is the volume of water in the reservoir at this time in cubic meters?
question.zh: 小华家新买了一台小轿车，小轿车的质量是12t，车轮与地面的总接触面积为0.12m^2.周末小华一家人开车去郊游，在某段水平路面上以72km/h的速度匀速直线行驶了一段路程，若此过程小轿车的输出功率是40kW。求：如果该小轿车百公里消耗汽油[X]，求这些汽油完全燃烧放出的热量。汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数燃油体积的值为1.5 L。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 400000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个大型的水库中，水位正常时水库的总蓄水容量为3,000,000,000立方米。由于连续几个月的干旱，水库的水位下降至全容量的59%。问：此时水库中的水量是多少立方米？

zh: [消耗汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [ mass of gasoline consumed] = [Heat released by the complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: Heat released by the complete combustion of gasoline

question.en: During "Golden Week," my dad drove me on a road trip. The car (including people and items onboard) has a mass of 2×10^3kg. The car traveled at a constant speed of 100km/h over a distance of 80.5km on a straight road. The average resistance encountered was 0.05 times the total weight of the car, and it consumed [X] of gasoline. The heating value of the gasoline is 4.6×10^7J/kg, and its density is 0.7×10^3kg/m^3 (assuming complete combustion of the gasoline). What was the amount of heat released from the complete combustion of the gasoline? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  inlet water temperature is 20 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 90000000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a laboratory, scientists are researching a new type of high-energy fuel. A scientist designed an experiment where he completely burned 1000 kilograms of this fuel to test its energy output. Through experimental measurement and calculation, he found that the specific energy of this fuel is 578000.0 J/kg. When the fuel is completely burned, how much energy is released?
question.zh: “十一”期间，爸爸开车带着我去旅游，汽车（包括车上的人和物品）质量为2×10^3kg，汽车以100km/h的速度在平直公路上匀速行驶80.5km，所受的平均阻力是汽车总重的0.05倍，消耗了汽油[X]，汽油的热值是4.6×10^7J/kg，汽油的密度是0.7×10^3kg/m^3（假设汽油完全燃烧）。汽油完全燃烧放出的热量是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数进水温度的值为20 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 90000000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个实验室里，科学家正在研究一种新型高能燃料。一位科学家设计了一次实验，他将1000千克的这种燃料完全燃烧，以测试其能量输出。通过实验测量和计算，他发现这种燃料的比热值是578000.0 J/kg。当燃料完全燃烧时，请问它释放了多少能量？

zh: [汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
[汽油的体积] = [汽油的质量]/[汽油的密度]
en: [ gasoline mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[gasoline calorific value]
[ gasoline volume] = [ gasoline mass]/[ gasoline density]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
Fuel consumption per 100 kilometers refers to the average fuel consumption of a car when driving on the road per 100 kilometers, which is a measure of a car's fuel consumption. Since most vehicles reach their economical speed at around 90km/h, the theoretical fuel consumption usually announced for the public is the fuel consumption at a constant speed of 90km/h per 100 kilometers. For a certain car brand, the fuel consumption for traveling [X] is 8L, and the output power of the car's engine is 25kW (given that the density of gasoline is 0.75×10^3kg/m^3 and the calorific value is 4.5×10^7J/kg). Calculate:
The work done by the engine during the time of traveling [X]; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 5000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An engineer is designing a new solar power plant. He plans to cover an area of 400 square kilometers with solar panels to maximize sunlight energy generation. Please calculate the area of the solar panel region in square meters.
question.zh:
百公里油耗指的是汽车在道路上行驶时每百公里平均燃料消耗量，是汽车耗油量的一个衡量指标。由于多数车辆在90km/h接近经济车速，因此大多对外公布的理论油耗通常为90km/h的百公里匀速油耗。某品牌汽车行驶[X]油耗为8L，汽车发动机的输出功率为25kW（已知汽油的密度为0.75×10^3kg/m^3，热值为4.5×10^7J/kg）。试求：
行驶[X]时间内发动机所做的功；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 5000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一位工程师正在设计一个新的太阳能发电厂。他计划使用太阳能电池板覆盖一个面积为400平方千米的区域，以最大限度地利用阳光发电。请计算该太阳能电池板区域的面积，单位为平方米。

zh: [时间] = [发动机所做的功]/[功率]
[路程] = [时间]*[速度]
en: [ Time] = [ Work done by the engine]/[Power]
[ Distance] = [ Time]*[ Speed]

question.en: The rated power of a certain brand of electric kettle is 800W. The kettle works normally for 500s, heating 1.5kg of water from [X] to 80°C. Given the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C). During this process, find: How much heat is absorbed by the water? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Calorific value of gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 30000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a high-voltage transmission line, the power company plans to use transmission lines with a voltage of 222,000 volts to deliver power from the power plant to a distant city. What is the voltage of the transmission line?
question.zh: 某品牌电水壶的额定功率为800W。该电水壶正常工作500s，将质量为1.5kg的水从[X]加热到80℃。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)。在此过程中，试求：水吸收的热量是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数煤气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 30000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在高压输电线路中，电力公司计划使用电压为222,000伏特的输电线将电力从发电厂输送到远距离的城市。请问输电线的电压是多少？

zh: [水升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水升高的温度]
en: [ Water temperature rise] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([ Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Mass of water])
[ Initial temperature] = [Final temperature] - [ Water temperature rise]

question.en: A car with a weight of 4000 N moves at a constant speed on a straight road for 100 seconds. The resistance it faces is 1500 N. The car's traction power is [X], and its gasoline engine efficiency is 20%. Given that the gasoline heat value is 4.5×10^7 J/kg and g = 10 N/kg, find the work done by the traction force. (Supplement: The power is [X];) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  final temperature is 80 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 400 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A physics teacher is designing a circuit experiment, which requires the use of a resistor. It is known that the total voltage of the circuit is 12V, and the ammeter measures the current flowing through the circuit as 4.44 microamperes (4.44×10⁻⁶ amperes). To enable students to calculate the resistance value, the teacher asks them to use Ohm's law to determine the resistance in the circuit. What resistance value will the students calculate?
question.zh: 一辆重力为4000N的汽车在平直路面匀速运动了100s，它所受阻力为1500N，汽车牵引力功率为[X]，其汽油发动机效率为20%，已知汽油热值是4.5×10^7J/kg，g=10N/kg，求：牵引力做的功。 （补充：功率是[X]; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数末温的值为80 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 400 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一位物理教师正在设计一个电路实验，实验中需要使用一个电阻器。已知电路的总电压为12V，而电流表测量到通过电路的电流为4.44微安培(4.44×10⁻⁶ 安培)。为了使学生能够计算电阻值，教师要求他们使用欧姆定律来求出电路中的电阻。请问学生计算出的电阻值是多少？

zh: [功率] = [牵引力做的功]/[时间]
en: [ power] = [Work done by traction]/[ time]

question.en: Taian Wuyue Special Vehicle Co., Ltd. is a large-scale production base for special vehicles. During the model test of a certain special vehicle at the factory, it travels at a constant speed of 5.6 km on a straight road, with a resistance of 3.0×10^3 N, consuming 1.5×10^-3 m^3 of fuel (assuming complete combustion of the fuel). If the density of the fuel is ρ=0.8×10^3 kg/m^3 and the calorific value q=4×10^7 J/kg, find: the heat released by the complete combustion of gasoline? (Supplementary: Fuel density is 0.8×10^3 kg/m^3; Fuel volume is [X]; Fuel calorific value is 4×10^7 J/kg; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 7000000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A town has decided to construct a new power substation to meet the electricity demands of local residents and businesses. The power company plans to introduce electricity from a nearby wind farm, where the output voltage is 25,000.0 volts. To facilitate large-scale transmission and reduce power losses, the power company decides to install a step-up transformer at the wind farm's outlet to increase the voltage for transmission to the town's new substation. The transformer has a turns ratio of 1500:1. What is the output voltage of this transformer?
question.zh:
泰安五岳专用汽车有限公司是一家大型的特种专用汽车生产基地。该厂某型号专用车在车型测试中，在一段平直的公路上匀速行驶5.6km，受到的阻力是3.0×103N，消耗燃油1.5×10-3m3（假设燃油完全燃烧）．若燃油的密度ρ=0.8×103kg/m3，热值q=4×107J/kg，求：
汽油完全燃烧放出的热量？ （补充：燃油密度是0.8×10^3kg/m^3; 燃油体积是[X]; 燃油热值是4×10^7J/kg; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 7000000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 某城镇决定建设一座新的电力变电站，以满足当地居民和工商业的用电需求。电力公司计划从附近的风力发电场引入电能，发电场的输出电压为25000.0伏。为了大规模输电并减少电力损耗，电力公司决定在风力发电场的出口处安装一个升压变压器，提升电压以传输至城镇的新变电站。变压器的匝数比设计为1500：1。试问，该变压器输出电压是多少？

zh: [燃油质量] = [燃油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[燃油热值]
[燃油体积] = [燃油质量]/[燃油密度]
en: [fuel mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion of fuel]/[ fuel calorific value]
[ fuel volume] = [fuel mass]/[ fuel density]

arguments.zh_name: 燃油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of fuel

question.en: A car travels at a constant speed of [X] for 10 minutes, consuming 1.2 kg of gasoline. The traction force when the car is traveling at constant speed is F = 1.2 × 10^3 N, and the calorific value of the gasoline is q = 4.6 × 10^7 J/kg. Question: What is the power of the work done by the traction force? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Boiling Temperature is 100 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 1000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a circuit, the power supply provides a voltage of 20 volts, and a resistor is connected in the circuit. The current through this resistor is known to be 0.005 amperes. Please calculate the resistance value of the resistor in the circuit.
question.zh: 一辆汽车以[X]的速度匀速行驶10min，消耗的汽油为1.2kg，汽车匀速行驶时受到的牵引力F=1.2×10^3N，汽油的热值q=4.6×10^7J/kg，问：求牵引力做功功率？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数沸点温度的值为100 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 1000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个电路中，电源提供了20伏的电压，一个电阻连接在电路中。已知该电阻通过的电流为0.005安培。请计算电路中的这段电阻的阻值。

zh: [牵引力做的功] = [功率]*[时间]
[路程] = [牵引力做的功]/[牵引力]
[速度] = [路程]/[时间]
en: [ Work Done by Traction] = [Power]*[ Time]
[ Distance] = [ Work Done by Traction]/[ Traction]
[ Speed] = [ Distance]/[ Time]

question.en: When using a gas stove to heat water, 2 kg of water is heated from 25℃ to 75℃, burning [X] m^3 of gas. Assume the gas burns completely, the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), and the calorific value of the gas is approximately 4.0×10^7 J/m^3. Find: how much heat is released by the gas? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  mass of 1g water is 1×10^(-3) kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 30000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A transformer station of a power company needs to step up the voltage from a primary voltage of 1000.0 V to an ideal secondary voltage. It is known that the primary coil has 500 turns, while the secondary coil needs to have 175,000 turns to reach the target voltage. Please calculate what the output voltage of the transformer's secondary coil is.
question.zh: 用煤气灶烧水时，把2kg的水从25℃加热到75℃，燃烧了[X]m^3的煤气。设煤气完全燃烧，水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），煤气的热值约为4.0×10^7J/m^3，试求：煤气放出的热量是多少？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数1g水的质量的值为1×10^(-3) kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 30000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一个电力公司的变压器站需要将电压从初级电压1000.0 V提升到理想的次级电压。已知初级线圈有500匝线圈，而次级线圈需要有175000匝才能达到目标电压。请计算该变压器次级线圈的输出电压是多少？

zh: [煤气体积] = [煤气放出的热量]/[煤气热值]
en: [Gas volume] = [ heat released by gas]/[ gas calorific value]

question.en: A team is camping on a mountain over 3000 meters above sea level and uses an iron pot to boil water. They found that in order to heat 2 liters of water from 10°C to 85°C, they consumed [X] of dry firewood. The specific heat capacity of water is known to be 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of dry firewood is 1.2×10^7 J/kg. Find: the heat released by the complete combustion of the dry firewood. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  rated voltage of light bulb is 6 V。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 90000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a large factory, there is a steam engine used for production that can generate mechanical power by consuming fuel. It is known that the power of this steam engine is 390,000,000 watts when operating at full capacity. Question: If the factory wants to complete a production task using this steam engine in 8 hours, what should be the power of this steam engine in watts?
question.zh: 某团队在海拔3000多米高山上野营时，使用铁锅烧水，他们发现把体积为2L的水从10℃加热到85℃时，共消耗了[X]的干木柴，已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg．℃），干木柴的热值为1.2×10^7J/kg）．求：干木柴完全燃烧放出的热量．上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数灯泡额定电压的值为6 V。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 90000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个大型工厂中，有一台用于生产的蒸汽机，能够通过消耗燃料产生机械功率。已知这台蒸汽机在满负荷运行时的功率为390,000,000瓦特。问题：如果工厂希望在8小时内使用该蒸汽机完成一项生产任务，那么这台蒸汽机的功率需要是多少瓦特？

zh: [干木柴的质量] = [干木柴完全燃烧放出的热量]/[干木柴的热值]
en: [ mass of dry wood] = [Heat released by complete combustion of dry wood]/[ calorific value of dry wood]

arguments.zh_name: 干木柴完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: Heat released by complete combustion of dry wood

question.en: The natural flow of water holds immense energy and is one of the important energy resources available to humans. Building hydroelectric power stations can convert the immense energy of natural water flow into electric energy, which is the main form of water energy utilization. There is a hydraulic project that has built a dam 115m high across the river, as shown in the figure. The annual average total water flow is [X]m^3. The main tasks of the hydraulic project include flood control, power generation, and navigation. In terms of power generation, the annual average total power generation is 6×10^9kW•h. Currently, 20 hydro turbines are installed, each with an installed capacity (i.e., power output) of 9.26×10^4kW. (The density of water is 1.0×10^3kg/m^3, g is taken as 10N/kg) Find: The gravitational force on the annual average total water flow; The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  calorific value of hydrogen is 1.4×10^8 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 50000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In an experiment, scientists used a large particle accelerator to study high-energy particle collisions. They accelerated a beam of particles to nearly the speed of light and then collided them with a fixed target. It is known that the total energy released in this collision is 1.2×10^15 joules. Assuming there is no energy loss or other energy conversion during the collision, what is the total energy released by the particle accelerator in this instance?
question.zh:
天然水流蕴藏着巨大的能量，是人类可以利用的重要能源之一。兴建水电站可以把天然水流蕴藏着的巨大能量转换成电能，是水能利用的主要形式。有一处水利工程，在河流上修建了115m高的拦河大坝，如图所示。年平均水流总量为[X]m^3．该水利工程的主要任务包括防洪、发电和航运，在发电方面，年平均发电总量为6×10^9kW•h．现安装水轮发电机20台，每台水轮发电机装机容量（即发电功率）为9.26×10^4kW．（水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m^3，g取10N/kg）求：
年平均水流总量所受的重力；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数氢的热值的值为1.4×10^8 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 50000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一次实验中，科学家们使用了一台大型粒子加速器来研究高能粒子的碰撞。他们让一束粒子以接近光速的速度加速，然后让它们与一个固定靶发生碰撞。已知在这次碰撞过程中释放出的总能量是1.2×10^15焦耳。假设碰撞过程中没有能量损失或其他能量转换，求此次粒子加速器所释放的总能量是多少？

zh: [水的质量] = [年平均水流总量所受的重力]/[重力加速度]
[水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [ mass of water] = [Annual average gravitational force on water flow]/[ acceleration due to gravity]
[ volume of water] = [ mass of water]/[ density of water]

arguments.zh_name: 年平均水流总量所受的重力
arguments.en_name: Annual average gravitational force on water flow

question.en:
Xiao Hua's father recently purchased a sedan, and Xiao Hua used his acquired physics knowledge to conduct a series of exploration and research activities on the sedan: After reading the instruction manual of the car engine, Xiao Hua created a diagram, as shown in Figure A, illustrating the energy flow in the internal combustion engine. The efficiency of the heat engine is the ratio of the useful work output (work done by the engine's traction force) to the heat released by the combustion of fuel. The calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7J/kg, and the specific heat capacity of coolant water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃). Based on the given information:

Based on the information in Figure A, please calculate the temperature increase of 11.5 kg of coolant water at 15°C that can be achieved by completely burning [X] kg of gasoline in the car; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  volume of natural gas is 0.04 m^3。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 60 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: An athlete is doing uniform speed running training on the track. Starting from the starting point, he runs towards the finish line at a speed of 8 meters per second. The total length of the track is 379.2 meters. Please calculate the time it takes for the athlete to run from the starting point to the finish line.
question.zh:
小华的爸爸最近购买了一辆轿车，小华利用所学的物理知识对轿车进行了一系列探索与研究活动：小华同学阅读了轿车发动机的说明书后，将内燃机的能量流向制成如图甲所示的图，而热机的效率为发动机输出的有用功（发动机牵引力所做的功）与燃料燃烧放出热量的比值，汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg，冷却水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），请根据给出的信息：


根据甲图中的信息，请计算该轿车完全燃烧[X]kg的汽油能够使11.5kg、15℃的冷却水升高的温度；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数天然气体积的值为0.04 m^3。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 60的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 一位运动员在赛道上做匀速跑步训练。从起点出发，他以每秒8米的速度跑向终点。赛道全程为379.2米长。请计算运动员从起点到终点所需的时间。

zh: [水吸收的热量] = [冷却水的质量]*[水升高的温度]*[水的比热容]
[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = 3.33333333333333*[水吸收的热量]
[汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [ heat absorbed by water] = [ mass of cooling water]*[The increased temperature of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water]
[ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline] = 3.33333333333333*[ heat absorbed by water]
[ mass of gasoline] = [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
A physics interest group heated 5kg of water using a coal stove. They plotted a graph showing the change in water temperature over time during heating, as illustrated in the figure. If 0.1kg of coal was completely burned within 6 minutes, the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), and the calorific value of coal is 3×10^7 J/kg. Determine:
1. The amount of heat absorbed by the water after 6 minutes of heating.
2. The initial temperature of the water is 20°C.
3. The final temperature of the water is [X].
4. The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Heat value is 4×10^7 J/kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression x * 1000000 - y * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a large power transmission system, in order to meet the electricity demand of the city, a superconducting cable is needed to transmit a powerful current. It is known that this conductor cable has an extremely strong current-carrying capacity and can carry up to 78,740,000 amperes of current. If it is assumed that the cable is operating at its maximum current-carrying capacity, what is the current passing through the cable in this situation?
question.zh:
某物理兴趣小组的同学，用煤炉给5kg的水加热，他们绘制了如图所示的加热过程中水温随时间变化的图线，若在6min内完全燃烧了0.1kg的煤，水的比热容为4.2×10^3/（kg•℃）煤的热值为3×10^7J/kg．求
经过6min时间加热，水所吸收的热量水的初始温度为20℃水的最终温度为[X]上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数热值的值为4×10^7 J/kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式x * 1000000 - y * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在某大型电力输送系统中，为了满足城市的用电需求，需要通过一根超级导体电缆传输强大的电流。已知这根导体电缆的载流能力极为强大，可以承载高达78,740,000安培的电流。假设该电缆正在以最大载流量运行，问：在这种情况下，通过电缆的电流是多少？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水所吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[最终温度] = [初始温度] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ Temperature change of water] = [Heat absorbed by water]/([ Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Mass of water])
[ Final temperature] = [ Initial temperature] + [ Temperature change of water]

question.en: Using a natural gas stove to heat 2 kg of water from an initial temperature of 30°C to 80°C, [X] natural gas was consumed. (Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C); the calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg) Find: The heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas; the answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  initial temperature is 20 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 6000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: A certain city plans to construct a large solar power station to meet the daily electricity needs of its residents. It is known that the solar panels of the station can generate 200 watts per square meter under adequate sunlight conditions. Assuming there are approximately 1500 hours of adequate sunlight per year, calculate the total area of solar panels required to satisfy the city's total annual electricity demand of 216 million kilowatt-hours. (Consider only the total area of the panels, excluding other equipment and facilities)
question.zh:
用天然气灶将质量为2kg、初温为30℃的水加热到80℃，消耗了[X]天然气。（已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）；天然气的热值为4.2×10^7J/kg）求：天然气完全燃烧放出的热量；上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数初温的值为20 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 6000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 某城市计划建设一个大型太阳能电站，以满足居民的日常用电需求。已知该电站的太阳能面板在阳光充足时，每平方米能够产生200瓦的电力。假设每年有约1500小时的阳光充足时间。为了满足城市一年总共需要的2.16亿千瓦小时的电力需求，请计算需要的太阳能面板的总面积是多少？（仅考虑面板总面积，不包括其他设备和设施）

请给出你的答案。

zh: [天然气的质量] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
[消耗的天然气质量] = [天然气的质量]
en: [mass of natural gas] = [ heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]
[ mass of consumed natural gas] = [mass of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en:
Natural gas is a clean energy with high calorific value and low pollution. Xiaoming's family consumes [X] of natural gas to raise the temperature of 5kg of water by 50℃. The specific heat capacity of water c=4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃), and the calorific value of natural gas is q=4×10^7 J/m^3. Calculate:   
How much heat energy in joules is released by the complete combustion of [X] of natural gas? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Liquefied gas mass is 10 kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 1 - x * 10000000 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: Problem: In a laboratory on Earth, researchers are observing the operation of a clock device. This clock runs with a special setting, making each second last 1.5 times longer than a standard second. Researchers want to observe exactly 700,000 "special seconds" on this clock. In standard time, how long do the researchers need to wait to achieve this observation goal?
question.zh:
天然气是一种热值高、污染小的清洁能源。小明家消耗[X]的天然气将5kg的水温度升高50℃。水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)，天然气的热值取q=4×10^7J/m^3，求：
完全燃烧[X]的天然气放出多少焦的热量？上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数液化气的质量的值为10 kg。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 1 - x * 10000000的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 题目：在地球上的某个实验室中，科研人员正在观察一种时钟装置的运行，这个时钟以一种特殊的设置运转，使得每秒钟耗时1.5倍于标准秒的时间。在这个特殊的时钟上，科研人员希望观察到整整700000个“特殊秒”的经过。在标准时间下，科研人员需要等待多长时间才能达到这一观察目标？

zh: [天然气的体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [ Natural gas volume] = [ Heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[Natural gas calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: Heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en:
As shown in Figure A, there is a health-preserving kettle, an appliance used for wellness, whose electrical power can be adjusted. The parameters of a certain brand's health-preserving kettle are listed in the table below. Please answer:

Now, with all other electrical appliances in the house turned off, only the health-preserving kettle is operated at a higher power for 3 minutes, and the indicator light on the household electricity meter (see Figure B) blinks 48 times (the "1200 imp/kW•h" marking on the dial indicates that the indicator light blinks 1200 times for every 1 kW•h of electrical energy consumed). Please calculate what the actual power of the health-preserving kettle is during this process. (Supplement: The electrical energy consumed by the health-preserving kettle is [X] kW·h; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  initial temperature of water is 20 ℃。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 6000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a nuclear power plant, technicians are measuring the electromotive force of a generator operating at full load. It is known that the generator has 1000 turns of coil and during the generation process, the rate of change of magnetic flux over time is 4656 Wb/s. Please calculate the electromotive force produced by the generator at full load in volts.
question.zh:
如图甲是一种用于养生保健的煮饮电器养生壶，其电功率可调。某品牌养生壶参数如下表，请回答：

现关闭家中其他所有用电器，只让该养生壶在较大功率下工作3min，家中电能表（如图乙）上的指示灯闪烁了48次（表盘上“1200imp/kW•h”字样，表示用电器每消耗1kW•h电能，指示灯闪烁1200次）。请计算此过程中养生壶的实际功率是多少？ （补充：养生壶消耗的电能是[X]kW·h; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数水的初温的值为20 ℃。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 6000 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在一个核电站中，技术人员正在测量发电机在满负荷运转时的电动势。已知该发电机的线圈匝数为1000，且线圈在发电过程中，磁通量随时间的变化率为4656 Wb/s。请计算该发电机满负荷运转时产生的电动势为多少伏特？

zh: [养生壶消耗的电能] = [养生壶实际功率]*[工作时间]
en: [Electricity consumption of health pot] = [ actual power of health pot]*[ working time]

question.en: As shown in the figure, the crane is powered by a diesel engine and has a weight of 2.4×10^5 N when unloaded. The total contact area between the tires and the ground is 0.4 m^2. Find: (g=10 N/kg, q_{diesel}=4.0×10^7 J/kg) The crane lifts a 6-ton stone vertically at a constant speed over a height of 2 m in 30 seconds. What is the power of the crane lifting the stone? (Supplement: The mass of the stone is [X] kg; ) The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Heating Value of the Gas is 1.8×10^7 J/m^3。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 10 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a certain industrial area, a machine operates for 8 hours a day, consuming 272 kilowatt-hours of electricity. If the machine's rated power is constant, what is the power of the machine in watts?
question.zh:
如图所示的起重机，由柴油机提供动力，该起重机空载时重为2.4×10^5N，轮胎与地面的总接触面积为0.4m^2。求：（g=10N/kg，q_{柴油}=4.0×10^7J/kg）
起重机将质量为6t的大石头在30s内沿竖直方向匀速提升2m，起重机提升大石头的功率是多少？ （补充：大石头的质量是[X]kg; ）上述问题的答案是[Y]。无关参数煤气的热值的值为1.8×10^7 J/m^3。在国际单位制下(例外：温度采用摄氏度)，其中[X][Y]对应物理量的数值表达式y * 10 - x * 1的值与以下这个独立的问题结果相同: 在某个工业区域内，一台机器每天工作8小时，消耗的电力为272千瓦时。如果该机器的额定功率是恒定的，求这台机器的功率是多少瓦特？

zh: [起重机提升大石头做的功] = [时间]*[起重机提升大石头的功率]
[大石头的重力] = [起重机提升大石头做的功]/[提升高度]
[大石头的质量] = [大石头的重力]/[重力加速度]
en: [ Work Done by the Crane to Lift the Large Stone] = [Time]*[ Power of the Crane Lifting the Large Stone]
[ Gravity of the Large Stone] = [ Work Done by the Crane to Lift the Large Stone]/[ Lifting Height]
[ Mass of the Large Stone] = [ Gravity of the Large Stone]/[ Gravitational Acceleration]

arguments.en_name: Power of the Crane Lifting the Large Stone

arguments.en_name: Work Done by the Crane to Lift the Large Stone

question.en:
As shown in the figure, a certain four-stroke engine has a piston area of 5×10^{-3} m^2, and the high-temperature and high-pressure gas produced by gasoline combustion exerts a pressure of 8×10^5 Pa on the piston. The engine operates for 10 minutes consuming 13 g of gasoline, and the work done is [X] (the calorific value of gasoline is q=4.0×10^7 J/kg). 

What is the power of this engine? The answer to the above question is [Y]. The value of the unrelated parameter  Fuel mass is 4000 kg。.Under the International System of Units (with the exception that temperature is expressed in degrees Celsius), the value of the numerical expression y * 7000 - x * 1 of the physical quantities corresponding to [X] and [Y], is the same as the result of the following independent problem: In a distant galaxy, there is a star named Zyron. Astronomers have measured and found that the surface temperature of Zyron is much higher than that of ordinary stars. Assuming its surface temperature is 480 times the highest melting point of known substances on Earth. The highest melting point of known substances is 4000K. What is the surface temperature of the star Zyron?
question.zh:
